description: Our facility, located in Beşiktaş Akaretler, one of the most beautiful and central locations in Istanbul, offers its guests 24-hour reception and high security services. The building is new and built in accordance with earthquake regulations. Our facility offers an elevator, free Wi-Fi and daily cleaning service. Full-capacity kitchen and kitchen utensils, washing machine + dryer and ironing facilities are offered free of charge in all our apartments. We do not have a parking lot for the building.

reviews.text: The room was nice, clean and quiet.The location is also great.We couldnt get any help about the late check in and car park.Even i saw one place empthy.Around 30 min i look for parking place.Once i have asked about those issues before check in, the staff told me they will help me but after check in, no help at all.
Extremely communicative and helpful, amazing place and very well located, will definitely book here again.
This place was great! Prime location and comfort. Will be staying here next time I’m in Istanbul.
Merkezi konumda ve temiz
Excellent communication and a convenient, safe location.

description:
This stunning Airbnb flat is not only located in a historical Beyoglu building, but it's also conveniently situated just a few minutes away from Taksim square and the Taksim metro station. This means that you'll have easy access to all that Istanbul has to offer, right at your doorstep.

In addition, the flat is also easily accessible from both Istanbul and Sabiha Gokcen airports, thanks to the airport shuttles that run regularly from both locations.

reviews.text:
• The location, for me as I travel a lot to Turkey, is the perfect one. In Taksim but away from noise & crowd. Very close to Haviast & Havabus + all ways of transport connecting to everywhere in Istanbul: metro, busses, tram, Funicular to Kabataş (ferry & beach side).
Close to all types of restaurants and cafe and bakeries.
• The house is practically furnished. Two big clean sofa beds with all the covers you need inside. Bedroom, kitchen and entrance. All wide and comfortable. All amenities you need are there and it’s suitable for long stays.
• Sedat is an amazing person. Truly. Very responsive and friendly. Great follow up. Makes your stay even more comfortable and joyful. 😍
My only cons are: bathroom is small for big people. I’m tiny so I didn’t find any problem. The smart TV is a bit small 🫣. And there’s no AC in the bedroom but one in living room can cool the whole house.
Thank you Sedat for everything!
I highly recommend this Airbnb.

Sedat's apartment had all we needed for a five night stay. The location is great for first-time Istanbul explorers - very close to Taksim Metro and the F1 and T1 lines down to Sultanahmet. The apartment is warm, clean, comfortable and the main rooms are spacious. The bathroom is small but we quickly got used to it. There is a large kitchen with basic cooking equipment and a good sized table for meals. The bed is comfortable and there is plenty of clothes storage space. The main drawback, as other reviewers have mentioned, is the stairs - three flights of winding stairs were a challenge for us older travelers with lots of luggage, particularly at night when the lights went off before you reached the next floor, and with no proper handrail. This is the only reason we felt we could not give it five stars. If you can cope with the stairs the apartment has lots going for it.

Even though the apt is on the 4th floor with long stairs and broken non operational lift, the place was spacious(family of 4). Host had good communication. Apt has one A/C in the liv rm and no A/C in the bedroom. There was a broken fan which was meant to be placed in the door of the bedroom and theoretically suck the cool air coming from the hallway which was also connected to the living room. Unfortunately the A/C capacity was only capable of cooling the liv rm. We requested the host for a working fan, and the host responded by saying that every visitor was comfortable with the current situation and by keeping both liv rm and bedroom doors open, temp in the bedroom would become bearable. A/C would had to first cool the kitchen, bath and hall then bedroom . We stayed in Aug 2024 and Istanbul temp were ranging between 90 F to 100 F. Our solution: my wife and I slept on the floor and kids on the sofa in the liv rm. If one cannot get a good night sleep, the place is not worth it.

we spent 3 nights in Sedat's apartment. i felt like i was at my own home. it s very large flat,tidy and clean. the bathroom was little bit small but it s not an issue. the kitchen is fully equipment. the bath is very clean. the bed is very comfy. the living room is roomy. i love the mirror in the corridor. there is no elevator. you have to climb the stairs. it s very nostalgic and historical building. tv and ac working very well. i was expecting the noise from the envoirement because the apartment is located eaxctly in the centre of taksim. There is a noise that won't bother a guy like me who is sensitive to noise. shouldnt be worried about it. higly reccommended. i will definetely come again.

We had an amazing stay at Sedat’s apartment. The place was exactly as described — clean, comfortable, and very well located. What really stood out was Sedat’s attitude: he’s an extremely positive, kind, and attentive host. We had a small issue during our stay, and he was immediately available and took care of everything quickly and efficiently. His communication was excellent and made us feel truly cared for. We would absolutely recommend staying here — it was a great experience from start to finish. Thank you, Sedat!

description:
Our apartment is within walking distance of all entertainment venues, touristic and historical buildings, shopping centers and is in a location where you can easily reach anywhere you want. It is possible to easily reach metro, bus, ferry and tram stations.

Taksim Square: 700 meters
Istiklal Avenue: 300 meters
Bus stops: 100 meters
metro station: 700 meters
distance.
Note: Our apartment is located on the 4th floor. (elevator available)
Note: The minibar is charged.
Note: We collect ID information for system registration.

reviews.text: The place is as described and matched the photos, very clean and tidy! Orhan is also a very responsive host and checked in on us during our stay. The receptionist when we checked in was also very helpful and gave us clear, helpful instructions and was kind enough to help with our luggage up the small flight of stairs to get into the building. The place is also a very good location within walking distance to Istiklal Street and many restaurants and convenience stores nearby. Thank you so much for the wonderful stay! We’ll be sure to be back when we’re in Istanbul :)

We had a great stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. The location was convenient, and everything went smoothly. We would definitely recommend this place to others. Thank you for the wonderful hospitality!

The Airbnb looks exactly like the pictures! It was very clean and everything worked as expected and I was grateful that there was an elevator. The place is very close to a popular, lively street called Istiklal St, which has many restaurants and shops, but it is far enough away such that we actually didn't hear much noise. We never felt unsafe in the area going home at night. Additionally, Orhan was a great host and was always very responsive! You can also leave your luggage at the front desk until 6pm. The only downside to me was that the apartment doesn't get much sunlight, so the room is rather dark, but that's not a major issue. Overall, I'd recommend!

The place was very clean and exactly like the photos; it was quiet and peaceful, with everything nearby. Check-in and check-out were very easy, and there are restaurants and cafes in the vicinity. Mr. Orhan was extremely helpful. I would definitely recommend staying here again—thank you for everything.
Great stay in Taksim! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and very well located. The host was friendly and helpful. I would definitely recommend it!

description:
Welcome to a stay at an apartment in a newly renovated historical building , which faces the historical tourist attraction of ISTANBUL "Galata Tower" ( From were you can have a breath-taking 360 degree view of ISTANBUL ) This apartment is centrally located next to major tourist attractions , right in the center of Istanbul.

It has every basic amenity you will need and is designed to make you feel "Home away from home" from the moment you step in.

reviews.text:
We stay at this apartment with our family with kids and elder. The access to apartment is easy, and completed with elevator, which is rarely available in this area. The apartments was neat and clean just like in the photos. The amenities were complete, and everything was well-maintained.
The location was in front of Galata tower, walkable to nearby attractions and shops. Don't forget to enjoy the truffle burger in 5th floor restaurant while enjoying sunset.
The host was responsive, and really helpful, especially supporting us on use of washing machine and heater. It was a hassle free process for us.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this apartment to other families looking for a comfortable place to stay.

We really enjoyed our stay at this apartment. It was clean, comfortable, and very well equipped with everything we needed. The host was very helpful and responsive throughout our stay, and communication with her was easy and pleasant.
The location is excellent, and having a lift in the building was a big plus. Overall, everything about the stay was smooth and enjoyable. We would definitely love to come back and stay here again. Highly recommended!

Amazing flat for a week stay for two couples. Really big and airy flat and super central, well located near M2 line, trams and ferry for trips to Kadikoy and overlooking the galata tower (although not noisy at all the flat is soundproof!). Everything walkable from the flat and great coffee shops nearby outside of the “tourist area” (but beware of the hills). The flat was well stocked, had all the toiletries you could need, extra bedding, blankets and dressing gowns. No issues with amenities, the flat had good AC and heating and good water pressure. Selin was also super responsive and very helpful! Our WiFi went down and it was sorted out immediately. She kindly also arranged for us to store our luggage before departing at a sister hotel 1 minute away which was a life saver. Would definitely stay here again and / or at the hosts other properties and would recommend the Airbnb to friends in a heartbeat, we had a wonderful experience.

The apartment was very nice and exceptionally clean, as was the entire building. The furniture was modern, and the beds were very comfortable. The location was exactly as expected—right next to Galata Tower, placing you right in the heart of the action. Within a two-block walk to the left, there are plenty of restaurants to choose from as well as a metro station. Walking downhill to the right, you’ll find the tramway station. Everything you could need is conveniently close by, making it a perfect spot for exploring the city.
Very nice stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The host was kind and helpful. I would definitely recommend it.

description:
Located in the heart of Istanbul at Taksim. Just 200 mt away from Taksim Square and Taksim metro station. Flat is ON second floor and it has elevator. It is bright and newly renovated. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 living room and 1 bathroom.
* Each room is equipped with an AIR CONDITIONER
* There are towels for each guest and iron
* 24 hours open market just 1 minute walking distance away

reviews.text:
My husband and I had a great stay at Tolga’s place.
We were there for 1 week to get to know Istanbul. Walking up and down the hills, taking subway, riding the ferry and eating the local foods.
Everything was very accessible within a short walk yet it was a quiet neighborhood.
The apartment was clean and free of clutter but the kitchen was equipped well and the bed rooms were very comfortable.
The uber can come right at the door and the apartment has an elevator so that you don’t have to drag the heavy luggages.
Tolga was very helpful and a great communicator.
We would love to stay at Tolga’s place again and we will recommend to our friends too.
Thank you, Tolga!
日本の方にも絶対にお勧めです。便利が良くて、清潔、静かな場所です。
Excellent location - central, walkable and easily accessible, very responsive host. Check in was clear and easy. Functional AC + elevator. Clean, comfortable, highly recommended!

I had a wonderful experience staying at this apartment near Taksim. The location is absolutely perfect — just a short walk from Taksim Square, shopping streets, restaurants, and public transportation. It made exploring Istanbul so easy and enjoyable.
The apartment itself was spotless, stylish, and very comfortable. Everything looked exactly like the photos (even better in real life). The bed was cozy, the Wi-Fi was fast, and all amenities were provided. It truly felt like a home away from home.
The host was incredibly kind and responsive. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and they made sure I had everything I needed during my stay. Their recommendations for food and places to visit were also super helpful.
Overall, it was an excellent stay and I would definitely come back again. If you’re visiting Istanbul and want to stay close to Taksim, this apartment is the perfect choice!

Highly recommend this apartment for a stay in Istanbul. Friendly host, good value, clean & cozy. Stayed comfortably with a family of 4 for a week & we’re very happy!! Centrally located but secluded enough to be a quiet respite from bust city streets. A nice corner market nearby and metro and all restaurants. Tolga was very helpful & I’d happily stay again. Thank you!!

We had a very pleasant stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The location is excellent - close to everything we needed. Check-in was smooth, and the host was responsive and helpful whenever we had questions. Overall, a great experience and we would definitely recommend this place to others.

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: Great stay for the price! The location was perfect, close to all the lively areas, restaurants, cafes, and nightlife of Istanbul while still feeling safe and convenient. Public transport and major attractions were easily accessible. The room was clean, comfortable, and had everything needed for a pleasant stay. Staff were friendly and helpful throughout. Overall, excellent value for money and a great choice if you want to experience the vibrant atmosphere of Istanbul without spending too much.

It was extremely loud I was facing the street and basically there was a bar that was right underneath so the music was so loud. Also, the bathroom had a noticeably bad smell I think from the sewage also the shower head the thing that held it was broken. I would say as a whole the hotel is fine for one night, but I would never be OK with staying multiple nights. The host was really nice and communicative, but in general the hotel rooms are really rundown and old, but the neighborhood is really nice so if you just care about the neighborhood, it’s a fun place to walk around. It’s really crowded though and very touristy But in general, the host was very nice It’s mostly just like the hotel room was not well taken care of especially the bathroom.. and I did not realize how loud it was gonna be which I wouldn’t have stayed there if I would’ve known the music is so loud it feels like you’re there and it goes on till like three in the morning

the hotel is located in one of the coolest neighbourhoods in Istanbul 😎 So much to do around the hotel, and the subway is only 5 mins walk. The room was beautifully decorated, windows overlooking a both lively and cozy street. Very clean and modern bathroom. Mini fridge wasn't working but they were very helpful and kind to offer the fridge in the reception. We felt completely at home. Going to miss the bed, it was soo comfortable. Can't wait to come back 👍
Odanın konumu ve temizliği gayet iyiydi, ancak sesten rahatsız oluyorsanız başka bir konum tercih edebilirsiniz. Yusuf bey de mesajlara hızlı dönüş sağladı, iletişim sıkıntısı çekmedik.

The room was very clean and the pictures online are an accurate representation. But beware, if you are a light sleeper, the hotel is located in a bar area where extremely loud music is played until the after hours.

description:
Experience a great stay at the heart of Istanbul's historic peninsula!

This booking offers a fully equipped 2-floor apartment in Pera with proximity to Istiklal Street, the prestigious Pera Museum, vibrant nightlife, and public transit options, all just minutes away.

With a famous Italian pizzeria serving delightful meals on the ground floor, along with our daily cleaning and attentive concierge services, we are dedicated to making your vacation truly unforgettable!

reviews.text:
This listing is such great value for money, and we loved staying here. It’s exactly as you see in the photos; tonnes of space, clean, and in a fantastic location. We walked everywhere and there are plenty of great places to eat nearby. It’s at the top of the building so be prepared for stairs; it won’t be a problem for anybody who’s able to tackle Istanbul’s infamous hills! The only downsides were a bit of a smell coming from the bathrooms and a tiny bit of noise at night, but we weren’t bothered by either and unless you’re very sensitive to noise or smell it should be fine.
We’re so grateful to Irem for hosting us at this lovely apartment and for being so responsive and helpful; we’d happily recommend staying here if too come to wonderful Istanbul!

I had a fantastic stay at Irem’s place. The property was exactly as described and shown in the photos. Here are some highlights:
• The apartment was spotless when I arrived. The linens and towels were fresh and clean.
•The kitchen was fully equipped with everything I needed to cook meals. The Wi-Fi was fast and reliable
•The location was perfect. It was within walking distance to great restaurants and shops
. Irem was a great host. She was very responsive and provided clear instructions for check-in and check-out.

This flat is an excellent place from which to visit all of Istanbul's major attractions. Public transport is in easy reach, and for those so inclined, the Karakoy tram and ferry stops are a 15 minute stroll down the hill. There are many restaurants, sweet shops and coffee houses, while a small supermarket is 2 minutes walk away. Our bed was comfortable, and for a short stay the kitchen and living areas were clean and comfortable. I gave this apartment 4 stars (rather than 5) for two main reasons: the upstairs bathroom smelled of mould; and, the noise from one particular bar was loud, incessant and did not stop until 3am. As such, sleeping in the top bedroom was very difficult. Although it was advertised that there were stairs, it should be noted that there were 60, which was a struggle when getting bags to the top. There was no book of essential information like where to put the garbage, best restaurants or local shops. You need such a book to stop people ringing about minor things!

One of the best value for money places I have stayed at. Great property in central location. The host Irem is very responsive and helpful. The place itself was very clean and tidy, and stocked with disposable slippers towels tissue and shower toiletry. I would highly recommend.

I had a fantastic stay near Istiklal Street! The location was ideal – close enough to walk to the main street for shopping, dining, and nightlife, but far enough from the bustling crowds for a peaceful night’s sleep. The private entrance added a nice touch of privacy, and it was super convenient with easy access to taxis and public transport.
The apartment itself was spacious and comfortable, perfect for a group of 3-4 people. The host - Irem - was incredibly helpful, responding to messages quickly and making sure everything went smoothly. She even came quickly to fix an issue we had at the checkin with the digital key.
The only minor issue was a bit of a smell from the bathroom commodes, but I believe this is due to the area’s plumbing rather than anything specific to the apartment. Overall, I would highly recommend this place for anyone looking to stay near Istiklal!

description: Everything you want to explore is right outside the door of this place.

reviews.text:
It was a wonderful experience staying at this hotel and l can highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area. The staff was incredibly helpful, friendly and always going above and beyond to ensure a comfortable stay. The propriety was clean an quiet. Situated right in the heart of the Old city. Whether it was local shops, restaurants, or key attractions, everything was easily accessible.
Moreover ice and beautiful cat is adding the charm to the hotel!
l would definitely consider returning in the future!

The hotel itself is quite old so the rooms and bathrooms are a little "used" and could use a bit of renovation, although I think they just repainted the walls. The 3rd floor with full kitchen and dining tables is a good plus. But mostly, the kindness of the hostesses Nini and Darina was amazing. They helped us, gave us many advices, served us tea and fruits all the time, gave candies to our daughter, made our laundry, and made our stay much more enjoyable! Thank you so much!

El alojamiento, está en un lugar con mucha vida, típicamente turco, muchos restaurantes, tiendas para comprar de todo, la gente es súper amable siempre dispuestos a ayudar, aunque no entiendan tu idioma. El joven de recepción, muy atento, nos dio recomendaciones para pasar año nuevo!…tuvimos un pequeño detalle con el baño, el joven lo solucionó al instante. Íbamos todos los días caminando hacia Sultanahmet y gran Bazar, está cerca y nisiquiera se siente la caminata. Es un hotel módico, sencillo, no esperen grandes comodidades, calidad-precio. Nosotros fuimos en familia, nos volveríamos a hospedar ahí.
El hotel cumplió mis espectadoras limpio aseado nos dieron excelente información en cómo llegar utilizando el transporte público

The staff were friendly and accommodating to our requests! When we stayed there, it was during Eid, so the faulty air-conditioning could not be fixed. They offered me a nicer and better room and tea.
They have a cute cat that stays at the reception, and a ginger cat that loves to sleep at the hotel entrance. If possible, try to get a room that is NOT on the 1st floor next to the zinc roof, the air-conditioning was broken and there was trash thrown on the roof.
Apart from that, most facilities were in good condition (kettle, cups, fridge, soaps provided). TV doesn't work but that didn't bother me

description: This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

reviews.text: The Place was very clean and looked just like the pictures, the place had all the amenities we needed, The location is just 1 minute walk to Istiklal street. The host was super helpful and he always responded fast with helpful suggestions.
I would recommend this apartment , they stay was very comfortable and location was very convenient , we loved our stay , the host was very helpful .

All the amenities are good, neat and clean property. Really good location to nearby spots, and I recommend to take this place.
The host is also a good person as he’s supportive if you have any questions or concerns.

I really enjoyed staying at this place! The host is really helpful and very friendly! The place is clean and the location is literally perfect.
Thank you for the honesty!🙏🏻🙏🏻

I loved this house, it was a small sweet house, very hygienic and clean. Hot water and internet never went out. Very close to Istiklal Street. The landlord is very kind and very caring, he responded to all my messages immediately and found solutions to all my needs. It was a perfect stay for me.

description:
Calm, cosy & fresh in a QUİET str. No loud nightly noises or mosques, this is a real plus in Istanbul! =D
Minutes away from the BOSPORUS, PALACES, ORTAKÖY, 4 beautiful parks, GALATA TOWER & TAKSİM
The majestic mosques & Bazaars: 10 min by taxi or different public transport+ some walking about 30 min
Walking route aprox 1 hour

Beşiktaş is lively & safe, a favourite w-Istanbulites. At a calm str 1 min from t'farmer's market . All amenities+cafes plus transport only steps away!
Nişantaşı 6minutes

reviews.text: I like to stay in appartement of Andromeda. the location is very convenient for everyone: shopping in Nishantashi, food market 5 min walk, 15 min walk to Besiktas ferry . Cafes and restaurants all around. The apartment is located on - 1 floor. And matches the photos. The hostess Andi is very kind, charming and pleasant. If you want to stay in Istanbul and save your money for the hotel, this is plaice to be !

Andromeda is simply flawless and the flat is a pure reflection of this. Extremely cozy, homey and clean! Location is perfect- one of the greenest areas in downtown Istanbul just 10-15 minutes walk to the Bosphorus. To my surprise, there's plenty of parks located nearby with some of the loveliest cafeterias and bars in Istanbul found just a couple of minutes walk. The spacious and clean apartment also has a lovely balcony where one could enjoy the fresh morning and have coffee (which is one of Andromeda's outstanding specialities). She is not a host but a true friend. Her company combined with her lovely flat will make anyone extend their stay!

Andy is such a great person , she really made me feel like I’m home … she’s there trying her best to let you feel comfortable and she has a nice sense of communication..she’s funny respectful and calm. My entire stay was great. The room’s atmosphere was perfect and the neighborhood is so peaceful that you can sleep till noon 😅 Andy and i shared a lot of thoughts during my stay , we went for drinks, coffee … we had such a great time and on my last night we were to the Beşiktaş Festivali together and danced like fools ❤️❤️ thank you Andromeda for doing a lot just to make me feel that comfortable…it was such a pleasure

Place's location is very good, a central one, allowing you to see many of the city's main sightseeings. The house is clean and cosy with a nice small balcony at the back giving the opportunity, if one freels like, to stay away from the city's hustle and chill out. But the most important - Andy is a super friendly and kind person, who welcomes you in her home with a smile and a positive attitude - it was as if I was staying at the house of a friend of mine. She was very helpful, giving me advices and suggestions about moving around in the city which made my first visit to Istanbul much easier. I hope that someday I'll have the opportunity to stay again at her place. Highly recommend!

I enjoyed my stay in this apartment. The location was great, nearby there were great coffee shops, the location itself is very close to Nishantashi. Apartment was nice. Andromeda was very kind, talkative, responsive, loved our conversations.
In the first day the room was a little bit cold but as soon as I told her she gave me extra blankets and increased the temp. Overall, it was enjoyable stay for me! Highly recommend!

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located place.
The building is 2-minute walking distance from the Golden Horn. You can quickly go to Hagia Sophia and the Ecumenical Patriarchate of Constantinople, or the historic center of Fatih.

reviews.text: The location although in a busy area is actually very quiet. The house is tucked in a small street so there is no noise from people or vehicles yet still 4 minutes away from the bus/tram stop. Very reachable and there aren’t any big slopes or muddy roads. The house is waaay bigger than it looked in the pictures, very comfortable and the kitchen is equipped enough. If I had one complaint (and if I’m really being picky) it would be the street which feels a tiny bit sketchy but not unsafe. Overall the value for money was amazing, the house is clean and comfy. Thanks!

Do not hesitate to book! Worth every penny of it! Cozy flat in a lovely neighborhood of Istanbul, with all the amenities one may need in a flat... Unbeatable location, just across the street tram and bus stops, u can get easily to any point pf Istanbul with public transport. Flat itself was very clean and had a well equiped kitchen. Furkan, as a host was always ready to help, if we asked for it... All in all, the flat itself and the host both exceeded my expectations...

My stay was great. The apartment is clean and organized, and the hosts are always readily available.
The neighborhood is great, with plenty of good and inexpensive options for shopping and eating.
The apartment is quite near to both a bus stop and a tram station, and also quiet
I highly recommend it!
Thank you!

I had a good time staying at this Airbnb in Istanbul! The location is within walking distance to so many must-see tourist spots, making it convenient to explore the city. The flat itself was comfortable and everything worked perfectly during my stay. The washing clothes service was an added bonus and really came in handy. What really stood out was the owner’s hospitality. They were incredibly helpful and responsive whenever I needed anything, making the whole experience stress-free.

Lovely place! Furkan was a super responsive and descriptive host. The place rocks as well with a great location and transportation connections with a tidy and well-formatted and priced apartment! Highly recommended!

description: The flat is located on "Tennure Sokak" in Beyoğlu. It’s a local residential street with a growing number of Airbnb homes, but it’s not a tourist-oriented area. That said, major attractions like Istiklal Street, Galata Tower, and Taksim Square are easily reachable within 10–15 minutes on foot, which is quite convenient by Istanbul standards.There are too many coffee shops, restaurants and stores along Istiklal street.

reviews.text:
I had an amazing stay at this Airbnb. The location is just steps away from Istiklal Street, restaurants, shops, and public transportation. The apartment was clean, cozy, and exactly as described in the listing. It had all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay, including fast Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, and a comfortable bed.
The host was incredibly responsive and helpful, offering great recommendations for local spots and ensuring my check-in and check-out were seamless. The neighborhood felt safe and vibrant, perfect for exploring Istanbul.
I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Taksim area!

Stayed for two weeks in April.
The place was very clean and had everything we wanted.
It is very safe and has elevator, in case it is needed.
The street is mostly quiet (there was a rooster nearby that was making noise during the day - but we were usually away).
Good location: many local stores nearby(corner stores, bakeries, fruit stands).
There are also 3 supermarkets within 12 minute walk (downhill).
There are hundreds of coffee shops/restaurants/clothing stores within 20-minute walk (over the hill).
Hosts were very responsive, and directions were very clear.
Internet is fast and stable.
Heating/cooling unit works well.
Overall - great place to unwind after sampling everything Istanbul has to offer!

The cleanliness was fine, though not perfect. I don’t really understand why so many reviews say the location is “central” and “everything is 5 minutes away,” because even taxi drivers struggled to find the place.
The host, Furkan, was very kind and responsive! We really appreciated that we were allowed to drop off our luggage earlier and even check in before the official time. It was a nice surprise to find an elevator in the building, although unfortunately it only worked for the first two days.
It was also unusual for me that you can’t throw toilet paper in the toilet.
The apartment itself is very pleasant — the beds are comfortable, the air conditioning is great, and overall it’s a cozy place.
If I visit Istanbul again, I’d happily stay here.

We stayed in this apartment for a week with our family. Check-in was easy, and the host was very kind and allowed us to check in earlier, which we really appreciated.
At first glance, the apartment was clean, especially the bed linen and towels. However, there were some details that could be improved: some dishes were not properly cleaned, there was a small amount of mold around the kitchen sink, and the sofa was stained. Fortunately, there was an extra sheet in the wardrobe, so we covered it. The kitchen had everything we needed for cooking, and the air conditioner was a big help during the hot days.
We had heard many warnings about the neighborhood, but we never felt unsafe. That said, after sunset we preferred to return by taxi. The nearest bus stop is about a 10-minute walk away, and the area is quite hilly.
Overall, we had a good stay, but the apartment would benefit from a bit more attention and maintenance from the host.

It was easy to book. Quick to get answers to questions. Location handy for Taksim square, transport, getting to Galata tower. Lovely local cafe 3 min walk, Turkish home cooked food. Area is Turkish residential , felt very safe and accommodation is as described and shown in photos. Clean and tidy, bed so comfortable. Kitchen well equipped with utensils, gas stove top, electric oven, fridge with small freezer. Thanks had a good stay

description:
Stay together in style in this spacious triplex near Taksim, İstiklal Street and Cihangir!

Perfect for families or groups up to 13 guests, it offers 5 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a large living and dining area, a full kitchen, laundry room, and 2 balconies across 3 floors (starting from 1st floor, no elevator). Enjoy comfort, character, and easy access to Istanbul’s best cafés, shops, and sights right at your doorstep.

Easy access to the city's attractions and a comfortable stay.

reviews.text: I stayed here with my family (which included parents) for 10 days and absolutely loved our experience. The bnb is located at the hub of restaurants, bars and a 5mins walk from Istaklal street which is one of the most happening places of Istanbul. The apartment is extremely clean and has all the things required for a longer stay including the kitchen and laundry area which was a blessing for day to day stuff. The host who we were communicating with (Merve) is a super helpful, kind and friendly person. She gave recommendations for a private transfer, salons and other things which were amazing. She went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable and well taken care of. If I were to visit the city again, needless saying, I would absolutely re-book this place! Great price for the value it offered and made our stay here memorable!

The host was incredibly kind, responsive, and proactive. She even dropped off some Baklava for us mid stay, which was the best we've ever had, along with other things like trash bags and toilet paper as we were low.
The location: It is a very busy street and the people who slept in the rooms facing the street needed earplugs. Otherwise, the location was impeccable and convenient to everything we wanted to do.
The building: Very old and unique layout. There is a cafe in the building and the main entrance to the building stays open till 1 am, people are always going in and out so we were worried at first but, there wasn't an problem. As for our stay, everything was clean but because the building itself is old, there are some stains in bathrooms and floors and such.
The beds: The mattresses were thin and not very comfortable. They also had extra sheets and comforters for us to use which was nice. Having AC in all the bedrooms was a huge perk.

There was a massive bathroom leak in the upstairs bathroom and toilet water dripped into the kitchen below. We informed the owners about it 5 hours after check-in, and we lost a lot of grocery and spent much time cleaning. The owners knew about this leak and the ceiling was covered in prior water stains. The owner still chose to accept new guests. We had no choice but to stay the night and then the owners demanded a cleaning fee of EUR 120 for us checking out as well as one nights rent. I do not recommend this place.
4.57pm: Guest check-in
5.45pm: Complaint: electric kettle does not work
6.11pm: Complaint: door handle does not work
8.05pm: Complaint: curtain is falling off the hooks
9.58pm: Complaint: Water leak in kitchen from upstairs bathroom

The place offered good value for money. The location is convenient, as it’s close to the metro, which takes you to the main tourist attractions. The only downside is that if you’re traveling with older people, the house is located on a slope and has many stairs, which can make getting there quite tiring and sometimes difficult. However, I 100% recommend it. As a young person myself, I would definitely recommend it for the price, and the place has very lovely decor. The host had great communication and was always helping us with everything.

We stayed here with a group of HS students on a school trip. It was a great location and plenty of space. It's essentially 3 different apartments connected through the central building staircase which was a little surprising but it worked alright for us. Clean, well decorated, and amply stocked. Do note that the kitchen is on a different floor from the dining and living area. Overall a great stay and would be happy to return!

description: Our house is in Tophane, the historical district of Istanbul. To go to the old city, you only need to go to the tram stop or bus stop which is 1 minute away. Galataport is only 3 minutes away on foot. You can walk to Taksim Square in 10 minutes or if you prefer, you can go to Istiklal Street with the historical Tunnel in Karaköy. You can walk to Karaköy Pier in 5-6 minutes. This apartment which has a really great location is waiting for you, our valued guests.

reviews.text:
It was actually best stay in an apartment we ever had, first of all clear and nice instructions of self check in, super clean apartment and it had everything for comfortable stay and even more: welcoming water in a fridge , shampoo and shower gel, grill sandwich maker and many more. We felt just like at home during our stay.
Location is perfect, just near tram line and Galataport
+ For those travelers with children building has an elevator that makes it really comfortable with baby stroller

A lovely host that communicated with us throughout. The property looked just as advertised and was clean. Comfortable bed and powerful shower. The property was located minutes away from public transport and good value for money!

The property was exactly as represented in the photos, very clean and tidy and Dilek was a wonderful and responsive host.
I would recommend this property to anyone who is looking to access the main areas of Istanbul, including the main tourist areas, waterfront of Beyoglu and a moderate distance to Sultanamet.
All round great stay

Dilek is a very friendly and hospitable host! The apartment has absolutely everything for a comfortable stay: clean and pleasant bed linen, towels, dishes. Wi-Fi works great. The apartment is very clean and warm. The apartment has a very good location, across the road is the embankment and a tram stop, so you can get to any attraction quickly and without hassle. There are many cafes and shops around. If you are looking for comfortable, clean accommodation with a great location, choose this apartment. Highly recommended! 👍

Great stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect- close to public transport, Galataport, and all the main attractions. Dilek was responsive and helpful. Highly recommend ☺️

description:
This peaceful accommodation is both close to the city and isolated. A unique experience awaits you where you can experience the four seasons. With its unique garden with its own pool, it is in a location where you can meet all your needs on foot.
You can have a barbecue with your family or friends and enjoy the pool.
25 minutes to Istanbul Airport
5 minutes to Kilyos Beach
You can reach the Belgrade forest in 5 minutes
An accommodation that will relieve you of all the fatigue of the city awaits you.

reviews.text:
The house was immaculately clean, so peaceful and tastefully decorated, creating an immediate sense of comfort, serene feeling and warmth.
Every detail inside reflected care and attention, from the living spaces to the comfortable bedrooms. Muratcan was exceptionally kind, always available, and incredibly helpful throughout our stay, making us feel less like guests and more like family member. All listed amenities were exactly as described, fully functional, and thoughtfully arranged to meet every need. The outdoor garden with pool was a true highlight — beautifully maintained, peaceful, and mesmerizing, providing a perfect spot to unwind. The entire experience was truly unique, restful, and far exceeded all of our expectations.
It was a beautiful, peaceful & calm location, the house itself was very nice, clean and organized. Muratcan & Ece were great hosts, always helpful.

Bizimle girişten çıkışa kadar ilgilenen Ece hanım çok ilgiliydi biz hiç sorun yaşamadık ama sorun olduğunda hemen çözecek kişiler oldukları belli🙏 herşey anlatıldığı gibiydi ev temizdi ve ulaşım rahattı market vs heryere çok yakın, salonda ve girişteki klimalar çok iyi calisiyordu yatak odalari bile soğuk oluyor, huzur dolu sessiz sakin güvenilir bıryer, tekrar gidilebilecek yerler listemize ekledik🙏😊

Muratcan ve Ece Hanım’a ilgi ve anlayışları için gönülden teşekkür ediyorum. Bizi kendi evimizde gibi hissettirdiler. Harika bir hafta sonu geçirdik. Yurtdışına taşınmadan önce İstanbul’daki arkadaşlarımla bir veda buluşması yapmak istedim ve aynı zamanda arkadaşımızın doğum gününü kutladık. 10-15 kişilik bir arkadaş grubuyla cuma gecesi bir araya geldik ve çok tatlı anılar biriktirdik. Ev hem konum olarak çok merkeziydi hem de oldukça şık, temiz ve konforluydu. Evde eksik hiçbir şey yoktu; her detay özenle düşünülmüştü. Ayrıca hayvan dostu olmaları da bizim için ayrı bir mutluluk kaynağıydı. Böyle güzel bir deneyim yaşattıkları için tekrar teşekkür ederim. Artık İstanbul için favori ve öneri listemizdesiniz! Sevgiler💕

Öncelikle ev gerçekten şahane, fotoğraflarda gözüktüğünden bile güzel. Yer sahipleri çok nazik ve anlayışlı kendilerine buradan tekrar teşekkür ediyoruz bu güzel konaklama için. Ev izole fakat heryere de yakın. Buraya kesinlikle tekrar gelmeyi planlıyoruz.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
The location of the apartment was very good and convenient, with easy access to nearby attractions and amenities. Check-in was straightforward, and overall the property was acceptable for a short stay.
However, there were several maintenance and cleanliness issues that should be addressed. The power socket next to the bed did not feel safe, as it was loose and partially detached from the wall. The shower was not as shown in the photos; the holder for the shower head was broken, making it difficult to use properly. The shelf/rack for shampoo and toiletries had also broken off and was left on the floor.
In addition, parts of the kitchen floor felt sticky and did not appear to have been cleaned thoroughly. The apartment became quite hot because there was no air conditioning. Opening the windows helped with ventilation, but since there were no mosquito screens, a lot of mosquitoes came inside.
Great location, but it needs better maintenance, cleaning, and updated photos.

Pros:
- very friendly and responsive host
- excellent location - easy walk from the pier and close to all the highlights of Kadıköy
- quiet and cozy, as the windows face the courtyard
- well-equipped and functional, with everything you might need
- spacious balcony accessible from both the living room and the bedroom
Cons:
- check-in was delayed and the cleaning felt rushed (though the host kindly offered a later check-out, which we really appreciated)
- the apartment is quite worn: broken shower bracket, chipped paint, loose socket in the bedroom, sagging sofa, table coming off the wall, a visible water stain and mold in the bathroom
Overall:
The apartment feels more like 3 stars, but thanks to the host’s hospitality, comfort, and great location, it’s closer to 4. If you plan to spend most of your time exploring Istanbul and just need a convenient, cozy place to come back to, this is a solid option - close to the pier and with a nice balcony to relax on in the evening

Gülay was a very friendly, responsive, and available host—a small leak under the sink was fixed the same day, which I really appreciated. The apartment is in a great location, close to everything with lots of cafés, shops, and restaurants nearby. The decor feels cozy and homely, and the place is well equipped with amenities and even house slippers. The balcony overlooking the courtyard was a lovely spot to relax and watch the cats. That said, the apartment is a bit worn in places—for example the broken shower bracket and cupboard handle. I also didn’t find the mattress very comfortable—it sagged toward the middle and I could feel the springs. When I first moved in, there was a strong smell of cigarette smoke, though it mostly dissipated after a few days of airing. The flat is quiet at night, though noise from next door or upstairs can be heard. All in all, a convenient and cozy stay with a great host, just a few areas needing upkeep.

The apartment is as its shown in the pictures, and it foresees an internal garden. It is located on the 1st floor so you don't have to climb lots of steps with your luggage.
The self check-in process is easy, and Gülay is a quick responsive host.
The location is the best feature as its only few mins away from kadikoy's central ferry station, kadikoy's metro station, airport shuttle bus and main bus terminal, and finally moda's charming streets.
The kitchen is fairly equipped but don't expect to cook full meals there.
The apartment wasn't dirty, but the cleanliness could have been better.
Some fixtures need maintenance.

I had very nice stay here! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is perfect — there are many great restaurants and bars nearby, and the area is full of cool designer shops to explore. It’s close to everything but still quiet at night. I also loved the nice balcony — a perfect spot to relax. Gülay was very kind and responsive. She let us to check in earlier and it was really helpful. thank you so much! I really enjoyed my time here and would definitely stay again. Highly recommended!

description:
The King Suite with a sea view is located in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world, within walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy, and Taksim, the heart of Beyoğlu.

It is in an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I can help my guests with 24/7 reception service to keep your comfort at the top, where they can stay as if they were at their own home

reviews.text: Location was the best I could have asked for. Can’t beat the price. It was close to one of the best areas in the city. All of the staff were helpful and kind. We loved the decor and balcony of our room. You can really see a nice view and have a relaxing space. Hot water that lasts for showers was wonderful. Having an elevator was also nice. Many restaurants and shops near by. Having help with setting up transfers was a plus.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
A Dream Stay with a Sea View – Highly Recommended!
I truly enjoyed my stay at this apartment in Istanbul! The place is not only beautifully furnished, but also offers a stunning sea view that you can enjoy every morning and evening – absolutely breathtaking. 🌊✨
The location is perfect – peaceful yet well connected to everything. The apartment was clean, fully equipped, and exactly as described. The host was very friendly, helpful, and always available if I had any questions.
What I loved most was the cozy atmosphere and the chance to relax on the balcony with a coffee while looking out over the sea. ☕🌅
I can honestly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and relaxing stay in Istanbul – whether for a few days or longer. I’ll definitely be back!

To be fair, the host was wonderful. He was very responsive, understanding, and genuinely kind throughout my stay.
However, my main issue was with the property itself. If you are traveling with children, I would not recommend this place. The elevator starts from the second floor, so you have to carry strollers, luggage, or other items up the stairs, which is quite inconvenient for families.
On the other hand, if you are a group of friends or a family without young children, this place is a great option.
I also experienced a problem with the hot tub, as it was not working during my stay. In addition, the shower water was difficult to use because it was either very hot or very cold, with no comfortable middle temperature.
again no hard feelings
it's like everything in Istanbul
the good and the bad is there and everywhere in the whole world.
wish for them all the best 👍

The address provided is inaccurate. They should provide the name of their hotel, it is a hotel actually. We take Uber and had a hard time walking with our luggage before arriving at the right spot.
The shower is broken. The water is either too hot or too cold. It was difficult for us take showers.

For the otopark, the price was different for what Fatih informed, it was the otopark changing the cost of parking , so expect that to happen, something that's common in Istanbul. If you're more than one then it's worth asking in advance for additional blankets, towels or anything specific, also get your own shampoo.
The view from the balcony was too beautiful , the room and the balcony are spacious, nicely furnished, the location is right beside Istiklal street which is near to everything.
The owner is responsive in messaging.

description:
A quiet corner in the city of Istanbul. In the bustling city center, find a quiet space of your own to create a relaxing place for you to stay.


✨ Great location ✨
• 2 min walk to T1 tram station, easy to get around

• Easy access to important tourist attractions

• Surrounded by Chinese restaurants and local food, you can easily experience the authentic flavors

🏡 Fully equipped with all amenities 🏡
• 24-hour security surveillance for peace of mind
• High-speed Wi-Fi, always online
• Air conditioning to adjust the temperature, suitable for all seasons

Whether it's a short trip or a long stay, Cheng Su is your warm home in the city. We look forward to your arrival. Feel free to contact us anytime.

reviews.text: The location is great, everything is walking distance. The host is a really nice and helpful person. There was an issue with hot water but he resolved it quickly. He even helped me with my luggage.
Just like the photos. Great place to stay. Very close to metro and restaurants/cafes. 15mins tram ride to Sultanahmet. Great value!

We felt very comfortable in the accommodation, it is located in an area full of shops, restaurants, supermarket and 5-6 tram stops by tram from the bazaar grade as about the very responsive host.
Thank you, next time we will definitely come back to you again
konum olarak çok güzel tramwaya yakın ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi rahat ve konforluydu tekrar geldiğimde mutlaka yine burayı tercih edeceğimm
Heryere çok yakın ve oldukça uygun fiyatlı. Tramvayın dibinde ve iyi bir ev sahibine sahip şiddetle öneririm.

description:
THE PERFECT LOCATION WHERE LUXURY AND COMFORT MEET!
NOBLE HOUSE 102
You will feel special in our modern and luxuriously furnished house in the heart of the city. Our apartment, which is a few steps away from the tram stop, offers easy access to all touristic spots such as Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet and Eminönü.
Fully equipped kitchen, high-speed internet, comfortable beds, 3 air conditioners and all the details you will need have been carefully prepared for you. Both a pleasant holiday and a comfortable accommodation experience await you.

reviews.text:
İstanbul’da ailece yaptığımız en rahat konaklamalardan biriydi. Eve giriş süreci çok kolaydı ve ev sahibi daha gelmeden tüm bilgileri eksiksiz paylaştı. Eve girdiğimiz anda temizliği dikkatimizi çekti; çarşaflar, havlular ve banyo tertemizdi. Mutfakta ihtiyacımız olabilecek her şey vardı, birkaç öğünümüzü rahatlıkla evde hazırladık.
Konumu gerçekten büyük avantaj. Tramvaya 1-2 dakika yürüyerek ulaşabiliyorsunuz ve Sultanahmet, Eminönü gibi yerlere çok kısa sürede gittik. Akşam döndüğümüzde sessiz ve güvenli bir ortamda dinlenebildik.
Duşta sıcak su, su basıncı ve klimayla ilgili hiçbir problem yaşamadık. Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğünün aynısıydı, hatta beklediğimizden daha geniş geldi. Ev sahibi de mesajlara dakikalar içinde cevap verdi ve her konuda yardımcı oldu. hiç düşünmeden yine burayı tercih ederiz.

Daha önce de Gülşah’ın başka bir evinde kalmıştım o da çok başarılıydı buradaki Konaklamamız da baştan sona çok keyifli geçti. Eve giriş çok pratikti ve tüm talimatlar oldukça açıktı. Ev tam fotoğraflardaki gibiydi; modern, ferah ve oldukça temizdi. Özellikle mutfağın eksiksiz olması bizi çok memnun etti. Kahve makinesinden tost makinesine kadar her şey düşünülmüş.
Konumu gerçekten harika. Tramvay durağına yürüyerek sadece birkaç dakikada ulaştık ve İstanbul’u gezmek bizim için çok kolay oldu. Gün sonunda eve dönüp rahatça dinlenebildik.
Evde kaldığımız süre boyunca sıcak su, duş basıncı, klima veya temizlik konusunda en ufak bir sorun yaşamadık. Ev sahibi son derece nazik, güler yüzlü ve çözüm odaklıydı. Mesajlara çok hızlı cevap veriyor ve misafirleriyle gerçekten ilgileniyor. İstanbul’a gelecek arkadaşlarımıza gönül rahatlığıyla önereceğimiz bir ev oldu.

The apartment was very clean and well-organized, exactly as shown in the pictures. Everything matched the description perfectly, which made our stay very comfortable.
Mrs. Gülşah was incredibly friendly, kind, and helpful. From check-in to check-out, we were well guided and truly felt taken care of. At one point, my father accidentally broke a glass, and when we offered to pay for it, the host kindly refused and was more concerned about my father’s well-being. That really meant a lot to us.
Overall, it was a wonderful experience for me and my family. If I visit again, I would definitely choose to stay here. Highly recommended—totally worth it and you won’t regret it!

Konaklamamızdan çok memnun ayrıldık. Ev hem temiz hem de oldukça düzenliydi. Mutfakta ve evde ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz her şey vardı, bu da kendimizi evimizde hissettirdi.
Konumu gerçekten harika; tramvaya sadece 1-2 dakikalık yürüyüş mesafesinde olduğu için İstanbul’u gezmek çok kolay oldu.
Check-in süreci hızlı ve sorunsuzdu, ev sahibi de her konuda ilgiliydi. İstanbul’a tekrar gelirsek gönül rahatlığıyla aynı evi tercih ederiz. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

Highly recommended place to stay.
The accommodation is very clean and exactly as shown in the photos. My family and I felt very comfortable staying here. The location is also excellent—close to the city center, cafes, minimarkets, and many other conveniences.
Overall, a great place and definitely recommended for anyone looking for a pleasant and comfortable stay.

description:
In our Loft suite on Istiklal Avenue, our guests have a comfortable and privileged accommodation experience by reaching directly into the apartment with a private card elevator.

In this unique loft apartment:
-Two separate bathrooms
-Two separate living spaces with high ceilings
- A private terrace
- A modern kitchen
- Two air conditioners
- Entrance area with washing machine on the lower floor
- 200x200 cm bed + extra bed according to the number of people
and a sofa bed is set up.

We would love to welcome you for a comfortable stay!

reviews.text:
I was looking for a central apartment in Istanbul and found this based on reviews. Initial communication was good but that's when the issues started. We were only given one key and as they couldn’t find it, they did not change the bedsheets or clean up. Between the hours of 7pm and 4am there was such loud music from next door (seemed to be a club), we got no sleep.
Bathroom shower kept backing up with water and never fixed, lots of mould and dirty seals. The big positive was the location but aside from that, I would not recommend.

Büşra hanımla iletişimimiz ve bize yardımları, lobideki arkadaşın tutumu ve yardımları, öncesinde özel olarak fotoğraf isteklerimize cevap vermeleri, evin birebir aynı oluşu ve temizliği, terası kullanırken çevreden veya binadan huzursuz edilmeyimişimiz hangisini anlatsam az gelir. Güvenle gelebileceğiniz, özenle seçilmiş evin tüm detayları, konforu, bence dikkatle seçilmiş çalışanları her anlamıyla bizi fazlasıyla tatmin etti. Bizim için artık her zaman bu şehirdeki tek tercihimiz olacaklar. Özel günlerinizi kutlamak için de muhteşem bir yerdi. Her şey için teşekkür ederiz
Great location but no washing machine in room. Spacious & lift access directly to loft.

Great location in Taksim with excellent access to everything. The staff were amazing, very friendly, and helpful. Everything was great from start to finish, and I really enjoyed my experience.
Highly recommended! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Really nice, clean, and stylish place. Easy check-in, friendly staff. Everything was great, just a bit noisy from the club until 3 a.m., then quiet. Thanks to Busra for the kind hospitality!

description:
Located on the lively İstiklal Avenue, one of Istanbul’s most vibrant spots, our apartment stands out with its stylish and modern design. Situated in a building with an elevator, it offers a peaceful stay thanks to its soundproof structure that keeps the city noise outside.
Fully equipped kitchen and Washing machine is available in the apartment, making it ideal for long-term stays. With comfortable beds and modern decor, the apartment is perfectly suited for both short and extended stays.

reviews.text:
Great, cozy space very close to Istiklal Street and Taksim Square. The streets around the apartment, including the street below, are extremely busy and bustling 24/7 -- however, the other reviews about the soundproofing and the windows are absolutely correct: closing the window immediately blocks out all of the street noise, while you stay close to all of the action. This works no matter the season, as there is a very effective air conditioning unit in the apartment! The WiFi is also very strong and fast.
The location is extremely convenient to anything you need at any time of day. There is one flight of stairs inside the front door, but then you can take an elevator to all upper floors.

Good location. Clean apartment and responsive and helpful staff.
The only thing is the address is No 19. However, the apartment is in building another side of the road. We didn’t understand why :) took us a time to find.
Noisy in the bedroom. Many crowded bars in the street.

My stay was really nice! I came here last minute due to issues at my previous hotel. This apartment was my save space! The location is prime to move around in the city, you are super close to Taksim Square. Communication with the host was lovely and always very quick. The furniture is a bit old already / its not looking 100% as nice as on the pictures, but I did not mind

Honestly a great place to stay. You literally have everything you need nearby, with any store you might want just a short walk away. It’s right in the heart of Taksim, which makes it incredibly convenient. There’s a street right behind the Airbnb that has everything you could need, from small or large shops to places to grab food, so you never feel like you have to go far for anything. The location also makes it easy to get around and explore the area since you are close to many attractions and main streets. After spending 13 nights here, I can honestly say the Airbnb is very comfortable and cozy. It feels like a place where you can truly relax after a long day out. The apartment is clean, well kept, and you feel safe staying there.

Herşey harikaydı, konum, temizlik, maksun beyle iletişim çok kolaydı ve her ihtiyacımıza anında cevap verdi..ayrıca daire gürültülü bir caddede olmasına rağmen ses izolasyonu o kadar iyiydi ki dışarıdan tek bir ses gelmiyordu..geldiğimde kesinlikle tekrar kalmak isteyeceğim bir yer…tavsiye ederim

description: Welcome to Terrace Sanctuary—a refined 2-bedroom apartment in Şişli where modern design meets everyday comfort. Spread across two levels in a standalone building, this stylish home is perfect for families, couples, or business travelers seeking a peaceful yet central Istanbul stay.

reviews.text:
I wanted to share my experience after staying here for one week in Istanbul. The hosts were lovely, kind, and very helpful, with clear instructions. The flat was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed, including Netflix and fully functional AC in all rooms and the living room.
The terrace was a great bonus — perfect for breakfast or a couple of drinks in the evening. The location in central Şişli was excellent, with plenty of restaurants and shops nearby and easy access to other parts of Istanbul by taxi.
Just two minor points: the street is a little steep, which may be difficult for elderly guests, and one shower drain could get blocked easily.
Apart from that, everything was great. I would definitely recommend this place if you're looking for a comfortable and well-located stay in Istanbul.
Thanks again to Ugur and the whole team!

This place genuinely exceeded my expectations in every way. The apartment was spotlessly clean, every corner, every surface taken care of. It's clear the host puts a lot of effort into maintaining this space.
The apartment is fully equipped with everything you could possibly need. The kitchen especially stood out all the appliances, utensils, and basics were already there, so I didn't need to go out and buy a single thing.
The neighborhood is quiet, calm, and peaceful perfect for unwinding. And the people around the building were so warm and friendly, which made the whole stay feel even more special.
The apartment itself is beautiful, cozy, and incredibly comfortable. I felt at home from the very first day. Would absolutely book again .. highly recommend!
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The apartment is soo clean and the host was easy to reach to the only concern is that there is only one heater for the master bedroom but not for the other room and the shower at the master bedroom was leaking water to the living room downstairs from the sealing.

Great hosts and a very large home that, on paper, offered everything I needed and more. Unfortunately, the street, the surrounding neighborhood, the steep hill the house sits on, and several facility issues left a bad overall impression.
The hosts are responsive; however, responsiveness means little when the home’s facilities fall below acceptable standards. The lack of hot water in December was a major letdown, and the blackout on New Year’s Eve was deeply disappointing. It genuinely ruined my New Year’s plans.
The neighboring homes are noticeably decrepit and derelict, which is something future guests should be aware of. The house itself is modern and refurbished, but it sits amid abandoned, crumbling properties. The terrace overlooks a neighbor’s backyard filled with trash, creating an unpleasant and almost unsettling view.
That said, the size of the house is excellent. The two bedrooms are spacious, and the bathrooms are modern, though without hot water they are effectively unus

This is a single house in an up and coming neighborhood in the city. This is extremely rare in a city like Istanbul where apartments are the norm. Super accessible to everything, very easy to reach by taxi. Very very private. They did a lot of work inside and put in very nice fixtures and appliances. Good hot water, beautiful private patio. If you want privacy and you also want to be close to the main attractions, I don't think you will find better. The sidewalk on the entrance is not finished. this is something that would need to be resolved by the city, I believe

description: Stay in a luxurious place close to everywhere you want to visit.

reviews.text: Great hotel, we stayed in deluxe with jacuzzi, it was absolutely worth it. Place looks exactly like on the pictures, and actually turned out to be bigger than we expected. There’s a beautiful rooftop restaurant, definitely make sure to visit it. Guys on reception desk were very nice and helpful, always there. Greatly satisfied with the stay
Wonderful stay from start to finish. The space was beautiful, clean, and comfortable, and the host was excellent on responding back to me. We would happily stay again!

Otel personeli çok harikaydı. Konumu cadde üzeri olduğu için ses bazı insanları rahatsız edebilir fakat camları kapadığınızda gayet sessiz bir ortam oluyor. Klima sistemi yeterli düzeyde. Fiyat ve performans açısından harika seviyede.

We booked the room on the spur of the moment after our other booking fell through and it was a great decision! The room was super clean. really large and airy with views over Istanbul . The bathroom was amazing and the roof terrace was a wonderful surprise! We headed up there at night for a drink and the views were amazing, then we had a delicious buffet breakfast up there again in the morning. Staff were friendly and responsive and we loved the area. All in all a great decision. Thank you Ersen!
Gayet saygılı ve tatlı dille karşılandık her şey çok güzeldi oda temiz konum gayet iyi yerdeydi her şey için teşekkürler

description:
This fully renovated apartment (August 2025) is located in what I believe is the best spot in Moda — just steps away from trendy cafes, restaurants, and the seaside, yet tucked into a quiet, residential street that offers rare calm in such a central location.

Our apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a 5-story building and is a bright, spacious flat that receives natural light throughout the day. Additionally, our building is equipped with an elevator.

reviews.text: Great location in Moda, close to tons of restaurants, bars, cafes but still quite enough at night time. Very clean and comfortable apartment. Canberk was very responsive and helpful.

Stay at Canberk's was good. Having a few large bags and traveling with a 2-year old, we appreciated the elevator in the bldg. The location was great, close to several bars and restaurants yet on a quieter street so wasn't too noisy. The unit was as described and looked similar to what was shown in pictures.

Our first time in Istanbul and this Airbnb was absolutely perfect! The location is unbeatable close to everything we wanted to see and explore. The room was spotless!!! I usually clean Airbnb or hotel rooms before I feel comfortable, but this was the first time I didn’t have to do a thing. The host was awesome.. always quick to respond and went out of his way to help us. We had a few hours between checkout and our flight, and he kindly adjusted arrangements to make things easier for us so that we wouldn't have to haul our 8 bags around Moda. I would 100% recommend this hoste and I would definitely stay here again! By far the best experience we've had with Airbnb!!!
Müthiş bir deneyim için teşekkürler!
This apartment is in a great neighborhood with lots of cafes and restaurants, but quiet at night. Comfortable apartment and considerate host, would recommend staying here.

It was a pleasure staying at Canberk’s place. The apartment was freshly renovated and exactly met the description. The location is great, very quiet street just a few steps away from the main local street with shops and restaurants. Communication with Canberk was easy and effective.

description: This stylish place is close to must-see destinations.

reviews.text: Great staff, helpful and we’re understanding with changing check in time due to a delayed flight . Rooms were clean and amenities worked well, location was about a 10 min walk to metro. All in all, great for the price😊

Super nice friendly staff even arriving very late .
The room was clean and as described.
Her şey olması gerektiğinden daha iyiydi. Oda tertemiz personel güler yüzlü konum mükemmel. Kesinlikle tekrar geleceğim.
Oda temiz ve fotoğraftaki gibiydi. Giriş çıkış kolaydı. Teşekkürler tekrar konaklayacağım.

Ich habe in diesem Hotel übernachtet und war insgesamt sehr zufrieden. Die Zimmer waren sauber und gut ausgestattet. Das Personal war freundlich und hilfsbereit. Die Lage des Hotels ist auch sehr praktisch, da viele Sehenswürdigkeiten gut erreichbar sind.

description: Experience the soul of Istanbul in this breathtaking top-floor loft, situated in a high-ceilinged historical building just steps away from the iconic Istiklal Avenue. This unique space blends industrial chic with timeless architecture, offering an expansive 5-meter ceiling height and a sophisticated mezzanine design.

reviews.text: Lucky's place is nice but unfortunately there is a bar downstairs that makes a lot of noise from 9pm until 3am .. it's not just a little noise it's like you were inside a festival even with the windows closed. This makes sleeping really uncomfortable even with hearplugs you can hear the sound. So, traveling with a baby makes the experience complicated mainly due to poor sleep conditions. Also, the lighting in the flat is quite poor especially in the room next to kitchen area. Lucky was kind to provide extra portatil lamps but it would definitely be better to have a proper lighting over there. Among that, the flat is relatively clean and nicely decorated. However, we were thinking that the rooms had doors but there is absolutely no privacy so you need to go with people you feel confortable sharing one single space. The location of the flat is quite good, very central area of Istanbul. And Lucky was very responsive and helpful with the questions we had.

We came here as a family of four with two young kids, and the apartment worked out perfectly. The bedrooms were spacious, so everyone had their own space, and the kitchen had everything we needed to prepare simple meals. There was even a small grocery shop just downstairs, which saved us when the kids suddenly wanted snacks at night! The location was quiet but still close to everything—we walked to a local market on Sunday morning, and it was such a nice local experience. The host even left a small toy in the living room, which our youngest loved. Those small touches made the stay extra special

We loved our stay here! The apartment is just one street behind a lively main road, so it’s quiet enough to rest yet you still feel the energy of the neighborhood all around you. The location couldn’t be better — cafés, shops, and restaurants are all within a few minutes’ walk.
Our host was incredibly thoughtful and made our stay extra special with a few lovely gestures — they left fresh fruit and bottled water for us upon arrival, and even recommended a local bakery where we had the best croissants. The apartment itself was spotless, cozy, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Highly recommend this place if you want to be close to the action but still enjoy a peaceful night’s sleep!

Contrary to some of the other reviews, we found the place pretty clean. The building feels very safe. Lucky was very helpful and communicative. The location is brilliant - right in the heart of Beyoglu, with easy access to transport, shopping and nightlife.
The noise from outside is really, really loud. It doesn’t end until 4-5am. It’s really hard to sleep during that. Have to sleep with headphones in. The windows and curtains don’t block any noise. The noise continues even on weeknights. I guess it’s a trade off for being in such a fun area, but would recommend improving the sound insulation.
The other thing I’d flag is that the aircon is pretty poor. Having it as cool as it could go does a pretty bad job at cooling the loft down. It’s not terrible, but not good either.
Overall the stay was fine - not amazing but not bad either.

The building is managed by a fully professional team, which made everything smooth and easy. I really appreciated the self check-in and check-out option — very convenient! The historic charm of the building combined with the beautifully designed room made the stay special. The location is excellent, with plenty of great restaurants nearby.

description:
Step into the spirit of old Istanbul in this spacious and tastefully styled 3-bedroom apartment, located on the second floor of a classic Beyoğlu building in the historic Kalyoncu Kulluğu neighborhood.
Set on Kurdelal Street, this inviting 100 m² home blends vintage character with modern comfort, creating an ideal setting for families or groups looking to experience the city like a local.

reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay here, although it was a bit small for 5 adults, but you can easily stay here with 3-4 and be comfortable. The apartment was nicely furnished and very clean. Location is great - 15 minutes walk to Taksim square and across the street from many nice restaurants and bars in Beyoğlu area as well as Istiklal street. Mert was always responsive and friendly and I can only recommend it :)

Overall, the place was clean, well organized and the host was very helpful. The location was also good. The only downside was that the apartment felt a bit smaller than expected, and it was slightly warm at times. Other than that, it was a good experience overall and recommended for less than 4 persons

Ev fiyatına göre çok uygun konum olarak da Taksim'e gerçekten çok yakın ve bir yerlere gitmek kolay.Evin konumunu bulmak kolaydı ama akşamları çok ıssızdı kadın olarak akşam çıkarken güvende hissetmeyebilirsiniz.Pazar günleri de evin önünde pazar kuruluyor hemen kapının dibine ,arabanızı çektiriyorlar ve gürültü oluyor haliyle. Yorumlarda olduğu gibi evin içi de güzel ama küçük bir de bizim konaklama sürecimizde banyoda kötü bir gider kokusu vardı duş almamızı engelledi.Gittiğimiz ilk gün çamaşır telinde lekeli pike asılıydı temizlik konusunda biraz eksik geldi. Genel olarak dışardaydık sadece uyumak için girdik bizim açımızdan genel olarak fiyat/performanstı ve uygundu.

Ev turistik rotalara yakinligiyla cok avantaj saglayan bir konumdaydi. Yataklar temizdi. Araba parki konusunda biraz zorluk yaşadık. Yakınlarında otopark var ama yoğun olmayan saatlerde bulundugu sokaklarda yer bulunabiliyor.

Mert Bey gerçekten çok duyarlı, anlayışlı ve ilgili bir ev sahibi. Kaldığımız evde bizim için uygun olmayan bazı durumlar ve eksiklikler vardı. Kendisiyle iletişime geçtiğimizde çok hızlı bir şekilde dönüş yaptı ve sorunumuzla yakından ilgilendi. Daha rahat edebilmemiz için başka bir eve geçmemiz konusunda da elinden gelen yardımı gösterdi.
İlgisi, anlayışı ve çözüm odaklı yaklaşımı için kendisine teşekkür ederiz. Misafirlerinin memnuniyetini gerçekten önemseyen bir ev sahibi. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

description: This modern hotel room in Maltepe offers both comfort and a romantic escape for couples. The room features a private in-room jacuzzi, a cozy bed, a contemporary bathroom, and a functional kitchenette. Its calm atmosphere, workspace, and high-speed Wi-Fi also make it suitable for business stays. Unwind together in the jacuzzi and enjoy a relaxing, intimate experience.

reviews.text: Temizlik konusunda oldukça iyiydi.Konum olarak oldukça avantajlı bir yerde olması bizim için artı olarak iyiydi.Bu nedenlerle memnun ayrıldık tavsiye ederiz
Oda çok temiz ve düzenliydi. Personelleri de çok ilgiliydi. Yolum düşerse tekrar kalırım. Her şey için teşekkür ederiz.
Temiz ve güzel.
Oldukça iyi konumda ve altında hemen çorbacının olması inanılmaz büyük avantaj

Excellent accueil, nous ont gardé nos bagages avant le check in, très disponible, chambre spacieuse, idéal pour séjour long, ne parle pas anglais.
Commerces et métro à proximité
Seul bémol, bruyant avec la circulation tard le soir et tôt le matin.

description:
From the moment you step outside this venue, you'll find everything you've been waiting to discover.
Sultanahmet is 50 meters away.
Hagia Sophia is 100 meters away.
Horse Square is 30 meters away.
All similar attractions are just 300 meters away.

reviews.text: The Airbnb is in a really great location only 3 minutes from the blue mosque and 10 minutes walk from the Hagia Sophia and at a really great price. However, it was quite difficult to find and therefore it took me a bit to get in. The Airbnb is placed in a restaurant which means that strong smells permeate the corridors and even the rooms. The rooms were large and had plenty of amenities, but we had a feeling that it hadn’t be cleaned properly. However, the staff were extremely acommodating: they were quick to reply, were very helpful and polite and were able to acommodate our needs very well and respectfully. Overall definitely a great deal, for the money it’s a very good place to stay!

Unbelievably friendly staff. Too notch service from before check in to the moment we left. And in all honesty very reasonable cost for being in such a central location within walking distance of important İstanbul sites. Lots of shops within walking distance and the Arasta Bazaar is within walking distance and worth a stroll. Staff were very courteous and kind to my children. Would definitely stay here again.
Best price and performance place. Kitchen is not so usable, pans were in bad condition so I couldn’t cook. However place is quite cheap for the location I am very happy

Very dirty--dust, grime, and hair are copious throughout the home. There is a noticeably foul odor in the bathroom, which spreads to the living room. The sheets and pillow cases are coarse and uncomfortable.
The neighbors were also noisy at 2 a.m. Overall, not a super pleasant experience.
Very great deal. Location was amazing very close to everywhere. Host was also very responsive. Definitely will come back here again!

description:
Stay in a beautifully restored historical building just a short walk from Galata Tower. This bright, spacious apartment combines timeless charm with modern comfort featuring high ceilings, wooden floors, and large windows that fill the space with natural light.
Located in the heart of Istanbul, you’ll be within walking distance of Galata, Karaköy, and Istiklal Street surrounded by cafés, boutiques, and local art galleries.

reviews.text:
The best apartment I’ve ever booked in Istanbul.
It is located in 5 min walk from Galata Tower and Karakoy from other side, in 10 minutes from Taksim and İstiklal.
Photos do not show how great the interior is, it has very high ceilings and a lot of space, fresh bedsheets, and even though we booked the apartment in the morning and checked in at the afternoon in a very same day, apartment was already cleaned for our arrival.
