I need to note that for me (an introvert) communication was exceptionally good, right after booking I was sent all the instructions I needed for me to check in, and prior checking out host already provided me extra care offering a depo where I can put my stuff in case my flight was later at day, all without me asking and reaching out myself.
Overall it was a great experience, will definitely come here again and again

Nice cozy apartment in an old house in the old center. all the sights are within walking distance. It is easy to get by ferry to the Asian side, across the bridge by tram, 1 stop to the tourist center, the apartment is accessible via a high spiral staircase. those who bring it up, it's not easy for everyone to get up. I didn't like the fact that the water smells strongly of chlorine, the water in the sink doesn't drain well and there is no curtain in the bathroom. Splinters in the feet sometimes fall off from the old wooden floor, it is better not to walk barefoot.

Galata Kulesi’nin hemen yanında böyle keyifli bir konaklama bulmak gerçekten büyük şans. Ev hem konum olarak mükemmeldi hem de içerisi tertemiz ve oldukça konforluydu. İstanbul’un kalbinde, her yere yürüme mesafesinde olmak gezimizi inanılmaz kolaylaştırdı.
Ev sahibi de son derece ilgili ve yardımcıydı, her konuda hızlıca destek oldu. Kendimizi resmen evimizde gibi hissettik. Özellikle akşamları Galata çevresinde dolaşıp eve dönmek ayrı bir keyifti.
İstanbul’a tekrar geldiğimizde hiç düşünmeden yine burayı tercih ederiz. Gönül rahatlığıyla herkese tavsiye ederim.

Great location. You can walk and be by the tower, taksim square, karakoy and galataport within 2-20 minutes. Apartment was bigger than we expected and can fit 5 comfortably. Shower curtain was missing however so water would escape to the floor, and the tub drainage is poor. Floors could be redone as they are very very old - bugs would be walking around sometimes.

The apartment and location were sublime. Few minutes walking from galata district with lots of cafes and restaurants. Easy commute to other destinations. Apartment was spacious and clean. We had a few days of rain and unfortunately after one day we had a leakage in the living room (Saturday evening). We immediately notified the host, but because it was weekend no one was available to offer an solution. No extra towels or buckets. The livingroom was entirely drenched by checking out on Monday.

description:
A peaceful 1+0 apartment with a balcony very close to historical and touristic places in the middle of Ortaköy

• 6-minute walk to the Great Mecidiye Mosque
• 9-minute walk to Yıldız Park
• 14-minute walk to Çırağan Palace
• 4-minute walk to Ortaköy Square and the pier

A peaceful 1+0 apartment in Ortakoy, very close to historical and touristic places

• 6 minutes walking to Grand Mecidiye Mosque
• 9 minutes walking to Yıldız Park
•14 minutes walking to Ciragan Palace
• 4 minutes walking to Ortaköy Square

reviews.text: I stayed in this apartment for a long term, and it was a very comfortable experience. The location is excellent—it’s very close to the port and surrounded by plenty of great cafes.The check-in process was very easy and went without any problems. The apartment itself was clean and well-equipped; the kitchen had everything I needed, and having a washing machine was a huge plus for a longer stay. One of the highlights was definitely the balcony with a view of the bridge.The host was wonderful—always quick to respond and solved any issues very promptly.A few things to note: it can get quite noisy from traffic during rush hour, and the internet connection was unfortunately very poor. Also, there is a circular staircase which is difficult to climb up, especially with a suitcase.Despite the minor downsides, I really enjoyed my time here. It felt like a true home away from home. Highly recommended!
her şey çok güzel çok rahat tertemiz ev. mükemmel konum. bir daha gelirsem tabiki de tercihim aynı ev olcak. herkese tavsiye ederim Ömer beye çok teşekkür ediyorum

We had a very pleasant stay and the standout feature of this apartment is definitely its excellent location. It is set in a beautiful and lively part of Beşiktaş. Ortaköy Square and the ferry pier are just a few minutes away, which makes exploring the city very convenient, including easy access to bus and ferry connections.
The apartment is simple and functional. We had a short stay and didn’t spend much time indoors, as we were mostly out enjoying the city. The host was helpful and responsive, and when we had to leave earlier than planned due to a health situation, we really appreciated his understanding and the quick support.
Overall, a great experience largely thanks to the location and the hospitality.

Ideal location less than 5 minutes walk to the quay, where one could hop on a ferry or frequent the numerous stalls and restaurants there. There is also a small mini-markt in the back streets. Only one minor issue: the cooking facilities were very basic, but if you plan to eat out this is not really a problem. An excellent stay and an excellent host.

My girlfriend and I were absolutely astonished by how affordable this beautiful place is. We purchased it thinking that there may be something that isn't in the pictures that could be wrong with it but honestly, the location is superb, the way to get inside is easy, the stair steps are wider than most so that's nice, lol. The only negative thing is that the home sits on a pretty steep hill so to get anywhere, you must walk and fight against gravity but it's not his fault, of course. He has no say in that, haha.

description:
Listing is a combination of 2 separate apartments on the same building, 5th and 6th floor, connected to each other by stairs,
5th floor apartments has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms
6th floor apartments has 1 bedrooms 1 bathroom and terrace.
Each apartment has living room and fully equipped kitchen.

Building has an elevator

reviews.text:
The flat’s location within easy distance of all the major tourist attractions is unbeatable .The view from top flat onto the river and city is breathtaking. This 1-bed flat would have been great for a couple alone
The host was very kind in allowing a late checkout.
We never cooked but kitchen seemed well equipped ( although it wld have been nice if pods were supplied with Nespresso machine- they not easy to find in Istanbul)
The downsides: -living room
In the bigger flat is tiny for a 3 bedroom flat.
- maintenance is not up to scratch . Pealing paint on a wall; one of bed sheets had a stain; seats and floor of the terrace were not cleaned, the sofa upholsteries need a deep clean; air con leaked moisture onto a bed ( thankfully host fixed the next day); some air cons were very noisy.
- had to threaten refund claim before host fixed 2 broken blinds that blocked the view for which we had chosen the flat
The two flats are separated by a dusty communal part.

Great location, easy access to Galata Tower and the end side of Taqseem street.
I took S5 (3 bedrooms and S6 rooftop) apartments, the rooftop one bed is amazing, the view, the setup, clean, with only minor issue with blinders that are not working on one side of the window.
the 3 bedroom one:
- large toilet gas glass doors with curtains, be worried if you have kids.
- small toilet smell was not ok, not very bad, but not ok.
- some of the ACs are old, with high noise at night.
final note, the elevator reach only 5th floor, there are stairs to the rooftop apartment at 6th floor.

Location is fantastic.Beautiful views from the balcony and very peaceful. Elevator major plus.
Bedrooms are large with comfortable beds.

Marine was a great host. He was very friendly and helpful. The apartment is great and the view from the terrace was amazing. The location is ideal for sightseeing and going out. Most sightseeing spots and restaurants were within walking distance.
Great location with beautiful scenery from the balcony and terrace! Very helpful host who was able to sort out everything in a timely manner.

description: Reconnect with loved ones in this family-friendly place.

reviews.text:
The house is located in an amazing place, Balat, with very authentic surroundings, nice cafes and friendly people. The apartment itself is equipped with everything you need. However, it needs renovation in some parts, e.g. bathroom. It suits for a short stay or as an affordable option. The heating works perfectly so even in winter it's warm inside.
Selçuk is very friendly and supportive. He responded quickly to our messages and helped to solve several issues. We appreciate his hospitality and wish success in further development of this facility.

De locatie van de bnb van Selcuk is perfect. Balat is echt heerlijk om tijd te spenderen en lekker te eten. Niet te toeristisch, toch levendig. De kamer was fijn, al hing er een sterke schimmellucht die uit de badkamer kwam. In de badkamer met de deur dicht voelde erg ongezond door alle schimmel op het plafond en vocht op de muren. Ook waren er wel wat losse keukenspullen zoals een pan en afwasmiddel, maar bijvoorbeeld geen complete bestekset of een theedoek om af te drogen. De vuilnisbakken waren niet geleegd. Het bed lag verder heerlijk en was schoon. Ook de openslaande deur naar het Frans balkon was echt fijn, evenals de goede gordijnen. We hebben de hele week heel rustig en fijn geslapen! Selcuk reageerde telkens binnen een minuut als we hem iets stuurden, en toen de stroom was uitgevallen heeft hij het direct opgelost, ondanks dat het al laat in de avond was. Echt een fijne host! We komen graag terug :)
gayet ilgili mesajlara hemen dönüldü ev güzel ve temizdi fotoğraflarda daha büyük grlmişti gözüme ama yeterliydi
Bir gün konakladım. Gayet temiz ve iyi bir yer tavsiye ederim.
ihtiyacım cevap veren maddi plarakda uygun kalınabilir bir yer. İlgili ev sahibi saolsun. tavsiye ederim

description: My place is suitable for couples, solo travelers, business travelers, and families (with kids).

reviews.text:
Nice, clean apartment near major tourist attractions in Istanbul. Fehmi is an excellent host! The apartment is on the fourth floor. Normally we travel very light and climbing stairs with backpacks is no problem at all. But this Istanbul trip was a part of another trip taken to attend a wedding--we were traveling with two suitcases, besides our backpacks. Fehmi was very kind to give us a hand in taking the suitcases up to the apartment. He also arranged for storing the suitcases in a carpet shop next door while we travel to Malta. [In fact, that's where our luggage is at this time].
Apartment Description: You enter the building from main entrance on the street level and go up to the fourth floor using a narrow spiral stairwell. You enter the small living room of the apartment, with kitchen facilities on the left, bathroom in front, and the two bedrooms to your right. Both bedrooms have windows on the street side. One bedroom (most probably 12 ft X 12 ft) has a queen-sized bed; the other one (most probably 8 ft X 14 ft) has a single bed and a sofa that can be converted into a bed. The apartment was very clean. [We feel bad leaving the collected trash bags by the door--there were no instructions where to throw away the trash, and we did not see a dumpster downstairs.] To go to Blue Mosque and Aya Sofia, you turn left, on exiting from the main entrance, and then turn right at the next corner. It is a two-minutes walk to the pedestrians-only area around the tourist attractions. A grocery store (Sokak) is a 4-minutes walk from the apartment. [Left on exiting the building, another left at the corner, walk slight uphill, store will be on the right.]

Wonderful price and location! Two separate bedrooms, no living space, and kitchen with essentials. Incredible area and super accommodating host! Wi-Fi was in and out, but worked well when it was up, which was most of the time. The bathroom had a sewage smell, but as long as you leave that window open and the bathroom door closed then it’s fine. Comfortable beds, good water pressure. Super close to all the top tourist destinations, and right next to some good food, coffee, and market places.

Fehmi’s apartment is wonderful! It is in the perfect area of Istanbul. You can literally walk everywhere.
The beds are both so comfortable and the sun comes streaming in the windows with a gentle breeze. The apartment is clean and well organized. There is lots of hot water with great water pressure in the shower.
It is in a super safe area. My sister and I felt very comfortable walking back to the apartment late at night. The hosts are so kind! I have actually already booked to return!
Book this apartment for an amazing stay!

Fehmi was an exceptional host and made our stay truly perfect. From the moment I arrived, his communication was clear, prompt, and incredibly helpful, which made everything smooth and stress-free. The apartment was maintained to a very high standard—clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
The location couldn’t have been better. It’s ideally situated within walking distance of some of the best attractions, making it easy to explore and enjoy the area without needing transportation.
Overall, this was one of the best experiences I’ve had. I would highly recommend staying with Fehmi and wouldn’t hesitate to return again.

The flat is located on the edge of the old town and all the main attractions are at walking distance. Cute cafès, good restaurant and also a minimarket are around the corner. The flat was very clean and the beds are very comfortable. The kitchen is small but it has all what is needed and we could comfortably have breakfast in three. Fehmi is a very kind host, he kept our luggages before check-in and after check-out and he has been very supportive answering all our questions. We would definitrly come back!

description:
Our boutique building offers the perfect blend of Istanbul’s rich history and modern luxury. Comprising only 7 private rooms, our property provides an intimate and peaceful retreat just a short walk away from the city's most iconic landmarks, including the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and the Grand Bazaar.
The building features a unique "Modern Ottoman" aesthetic, where traditional architectural details meet sleek, contemporary interiors.

reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the hotel! The room was cozy and comfortable, had everything I needed as someone working remotely. The staff were so kind and helpful. The neighborhood is bustling and vibrant yet I always felt safe. You get such an authentic feel of Istanbul staying here. And it’s right next to the metro! I pretty much walked everywhere though, only 30 minutes to the central attractions! Don’t skip this spot. It’s a great deal!

The lady working at the reception was fantastic, the room was clean, the bed was compfy. But:
- the A/C was taking approx 10 min each time to respond the remote correctly.
- the ceiling multiplied all the sound of upper floor neighborhoods, it was shaking at every step.
- the room looks over a courtyard with a few terribly noisy neighbors, on my second night, one was playing music out loud literally the whole night, and did not bother my warnings.

This room is really good. Neighborhood is calm near the grand bazaar and host is super responsive understanding and helpful.
The balcony view is of other apartment buildings so blinds had to stay closed but otherwise 5/5 i highly recommend.
her yerr çok yakın sakin bi yer tertemiz ve düzenli ayrica butun aletleri de sorunsuz calisiyor biz cok begendik cok ferah bi muhit.Kesinlikle bir daha gelicez.
konumu gayet hoş fiyatına göre gayet iyi bir konaklama

description:
💛 Welcome to your place in Taksim
Cozy private studio, carefully prepared to make you feel at home.

🛏️ Comfort and privacy
Private bathroom and kitchen · satin sheets · clean towels
🧼 Very high level of cleanliness and hygiene
🔐 Easy access
Automated entry with password · easy check-in

•There’s lots of natural light everywhere.

6. Hosts are responsive and helpful. Manager is extremely responsive and helpful. Very nice people.
7. Very clean.
8. Hey a free bottle of water!
9. Very private.
Cons:
1. Touristy, so immediate area prices are a bit high. Some noise from street.
2. Third floor (4th, if you go by USA numbering), so it's a workout
3. Wi-fi is not very good.
Overall loved the place. Would highly recommend. Can't stress how responsive manager is.

The place was as described, with three bedrooms and a central location right next to Galata Tower. The kitchen was also well appointed and we appreciated the tea, coffee and sugar. We dealt with Tashkin, who manages the place for the hosts, and he was super responsive and brought us a crib for our son immediately after it was initially forgotten. I would recommend this place for anyone looking for a central location.
But I would echo the other reviews about needing to navigate multiple steep hills, as well as a fairly steep slippery marble staircase in an old building to get to this apartment. The apartment is also quite sparse/hasn’t been fully decorated but I’m guessing that’s due to recent renovation.
In hindsight, even though we could handle it, it wasn’t the ideal choice for a toddler and our other young child, given the traffic, overall crowds and construction, and steep location. But none of that takes away from the apartment, which was as described. Thank you for hosting us

The location of this Airbnb is fantastic—just a few meters from the Galata Tower, with super convenient transit and tons of great restaurants right around the corner. The apartment itself was very clean and well-stocked with all the essential amenities.
However, there are a few drawbacks to keep in mind:
1.Noise Level: Because of its proximity to Galata Tower, the street outside is extremely lively and noisy until late at night. The windows don't block out much sound, so it can be difficult to sleep if you are a light sleeper.
2. Wi-Fi: The internet connection was very and practically unusable. Speeds were only around a few hundred kbps—even loading a simple picture was a struggle, and streaming video was completely out of the question.
3. Accessibility: Our room was on the 3rd floor with no elevator. The building has a marble spiral staircase, which made hauling heavy luggage up and down quite a workout.
Overall, it’s a great spot if you want to be right in the heart of the action,

Stunning apartment! Wooden floors, high ceilings, unbeatable location right by the tower. Super comfy beds and really clean, had all the necessities even bottled water. The hosts were very helpful and responsive, we had a great stay. Be advised that it's stairs only and on the 3rd floor, if you have big luggage or mobility limitations. I really can't fault this place, 5 star stay!

We LOVED our stay in this place. It was very clean, spacious, and had everything we needed in terms of amenities.
The location is perfect with easy access to key touristic places, and you can almost touch Galata tower from the windows of the living room. And it also feels very safe. The only downside of the location is that a lot of noise can come in as galata square is right there under the windows. It could also sometimes be loud through the night, like someone singing away in the middle of the night. Again, downside of being ultra central.
The communication was great, the team supporting the guests on the ground were super helpful and answered any questions we had right away.
The marble stairs in the apartment are beautiful but also a pain to go up and down, specially if you are carrying luggages. We had asked for a porter to be arranged and it was definitely necessary. But without luggages and for our daily use, it wasn't really that bad, even for may parents who are in their 60s.
The internet was also speedy and reliable, myself and my partner had many hours of meetings on our remote work without any trouble . An extension to the router is necessary though as some of the rooms in the apartment had very weak signals.
Overall, one of the best airbnbs I have stayed in, and I would defo recommend and stay again next time we are in Istanbul.

description:
Have a pleasant holiday in our spacious and cozy home with a panoramic sea view at Heybeli Island!

You can have a pleasant holiday in our house with a panoramic view, spacious and warm decoration in Heybeli Island!

reviews.text: Hamdi's place is a good value, you will be pleased you chose his listing. Very clean, beautiful views and good location. I arrived early in the morning and Hamdi greeted me at the ferry, and stored my things while I explored the island on foot for several hours before checkin. He advised me on the best walking route which gave a nice overview of the island. His welcome included Turkish coffee and bottled water for my walk. My stay was very peaceful and it felt like home.I was sad to leave. I look forward to staying at Hamdi's when I return to the island in the future. Thank you Hamdi!

Eğer mümkün olsaydı, bu seyahatime 5 yıldız değil, 100 yıldız verirdim. Öncelikle mekandan bahsedeyim. Toplam 25 sene Istanbul'da yaşamış birisi olarak ben hiç böylesine muhteşem bir manazarayı böylesine huzurlu bir mekandan seyretmedim. Evin en üst katında kapatılmış terasın pencerelerini açtığınızda içeri dolan temiz hava, onun eşliğinde alabildiğine deniz ve Istanbul manzarası, akşama doğru sol tarafınızda batan güneş ve sağ tarafınızdan doğan ay ve yakamoz... Tablodan çıkma, büyülü bir ev! Bunun yanında kalabalık gruplar için de inanılmaz rahat kalınabilir. Biz 4 kişi kaldık ve manzaraya aşık olduğum için eşimle odada yatmak yerine balkonda manzara ile uyudum her gece.
Şimdi gelelim Hamdi abiye. Hamdi abi bir "ev sahibi" değil, sanki çok yakın bir akrabamız. Geldiğimde sanki dayım beni karşılamış da ağırlıyormuş gibi hissettim. Yardımseverliği ve sürprizleri ile artık ömürlük bir abimiz oldu bizim için. Her sabah bahçeden taze kopardığı salatalık, nane, biber ve böğürtlenler ile günaydın demesi. Bizleri üşenmeden adanın en yerel lezzetlerine götürmesi, sevgisi ve konukseverliği ile kendimizi evimizden bile rahat hissettirmesi... Hayatımın büyük çoğunluğunda gezen biri olarak asla ama asla unutmayacağım bir deneyim yaşattı bize. Keşke Airbnb "en iyi ev sahibi" ödülü verse, Hamdi abi her sene kazanırdı!
Eğer Istanbul'da kalacaksanız ama insan kalabalığından ve sesten uzakta zaman geçirmek istiyorsanız hiç başka bir yer aramayın. İleride yalnız başıma iş için geldiğimde bile otelde kalmak yerine Hamdi abide kalacağım! Herşey için teşekkürler!
-------
Now the English version.
I've met the "best of the best host" in Airbnb; Mr. Hamdi. He was the most helpful, decent, sweet person I've ever met in Istanbul and full of surprises. He greeted us every morning with fresh cucumbers, peppers and various herbs from his own garden... Every single morning! He showed us around with his motor bike, took us to local places to taste the best food and showed us the most spectacular corners of the island. If there were "best host rewards" in Airbnb, Mr. Hamdi would win every year!
The place? Breathtaking! The moment we entered the house and arrived the closed terrace at the top floor, I fell in love! So much that I slept in this room instead of sleeping with my wife because I wanted to experience every moment possible during my stay. The view from the windows, the fresh sea breeze, sunset on your left and moon rise on your right... Just like a dream.
Mr. Hamdi and his place was the best ever experience I've ever had in my Airbnb history. I want to thank him to be such an awesome person and can't wait to come and stay at his place whenever I visit Istanbul. I'd prefer even when I come for work and stay instead of 5 star hotels!

Hamdi is incredibly kind and helpful! Mind you he doesn’t speak any English so we communicated with his duaghter most of the time but she was darling and super quick and helpful with her responses! The apartment has an absolutely gorgeous view! And the island is very beautiful aswell (1 of 4) . Mind you it is a bit far from the city but I believe it is worth it :) for us it was about a 45 min ($25) taxi ride from Istanbul airport to the port Eminönü then a 1hr 30min ferry ride ($2) to the island and then another 10 min walk to Hamdis home. Hamdi does have his mini car where he can transport all the luggage to and from the home which is 1000% helpful considering the elevation. All in all the home is clean very humble and the view is priceless. The transportation to and from the city center of Istanbul is very cheap but long (1-2hr) however the hospitality and view of the home beats this :) I recommend his home anytime.

Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi kusursuz bir manzaraya sahip. Eve ilk girdiğimiz andan itibaren tertemiz bir koku bizi karşıladı. Hamdi abi saat geç olsa da bizi vapur iskelesinden aldı ve küçük bir ada turu yaparak eve götürdü. Ev hakkında gerekli bilgiler verdi. Mutfak biraz küçük olsa da gerekli tüm mutfak eşyaları mevcuttu ve tertemizdi. Banyo da oldukça ferah ve temizdi. Yatak odası yeterliydi ve çarşaflar temizdi. İki kişiye vücut ve saç havlusu bulunuyordu. Salon büyüktü ve koltuklar rahattı. Koltuklar açılabilir olduğundan dolayı 2 den fazla misafir kalabilir. Balkon mükemmeldi. Tüm adalar ve İstanbul ayaklarınızın altında gibi hissettik. Yenilen ve içilen her şey ekstra insana zevk veriyor. Hamdi abi bebekleri de düşünerek onlara bir bebek sandalyesi koymuş. Ertesi gün Hamdi abi bize büyük bir ada turu yaptırdı ve tarihi anlamda da rehber oldu. Fiyat ve konfor açısından fazlasını hak ediyor. Eğer bir haftasonu planınız varsa kesinlikle Hamdi abinin misafiri olmalısınız.

It's worth the climb up the hill for the astounding view to the water and beyond to Istanbul. But what we liked the most is looking down from the porch as almost every roof nearby had seagull families and the small babies were walking around and testing their wings while learning to fly. Hamdi is a responsive host
Would definitely stay here again.

description: Family room for up to 4 guests. It has two separate areas: a small bedroom with 1 double bed and another area with 2 single beds. The room is on the semi-basement floor with small windows and limited natural daylight. It is very quiet. Includes a private bathroom, 2 air conditioners, heating, TV, microwave, kettle and mini refrigerator. Located in historic Sultanahmet, about a 3–5 minute walk from the sea and within walking distance of Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque.

reviews.text:
Cons:
- Main problem with this apartment is that it smells terribly damp. It’s located on the ground floor and doesn’t get much fresh air, especially the bedroom. It’s also quite chilly in there, especially in the morning (in April).
- In the photos, it looked like there were power outlets near the bed for charging devices, but in reality they are just holes. There are no outlets in the bedroom at all.
- The teapot is very dirty; there are cups, but no spoons or other tableware.
- The shower is convenient, but it leaks from the bottom.
- The sink is small and inconvenient because it’s right up against the door.
- The hairdryer looks old, and the wires are heavily worn. It works, but should probably be replaced.
- The bedroom door doesn’t close properly.
- Needs renovation.
Pros:
- Very quiet location, and not far from the main attractions.
- The cleaner is responsive and made an effort.
! The price for this apartment shouldn’t be more than $30/night until the main issues are fixed.

Nice hotel with hospitable and helping staff.
The room was warm thanks to the big air conditioner which could heat the room in 15 min. (we rent the room in the middle of December).
The room was clean, also it was cleaned by the staff during our stay.
Wifi sometimes was not working well - internet speed was low most of the time, but staff worked on this issue and in the end of our stay internet speed has become fine.
During our stay there was a lot of rains in Istanbul, host proposed free umbrellas which was very helpful.
Near the hotel (3 min walk) there are two restaurants with local cuisine with prices less than in other restaurants. The food there was delicious (one restaurant is "Begonville", another one - "Kebab House"). We spent a week in Instanbul and ate there only.
For those who will rent a room on the firtst (ground) floor, please notice that reception could be noisy sometimes (because of checking in/out guests I guess) and this noise is very audible in the room. We faced this only once, as it was December and there were not many guests.
In general, recommend this place for stay!

We were never that disappointed by an AirBnB flat. We cannot possibly understand the very positive comments. The host is great, but the flat has a range of major problems:
- It is wet! There is a major problem with water infiltration. The towels did not dry and began to smell. All the flat smells like a cave.
- The flat is not adapted for four people (a family). Both rooms are not independant and the doors make a horrible sound. Everybody wakes up when someone goes to toilet at night.
- The sofa-bed in the living room is VERY uncomfortable. If you want to sleep on it, your back will heart. Ok perhaps only for children.
- You hear the main door slapping loud from the bedroom, as well as the people speaking when they come home (sometimes at 2 AM).
- The floor was not clean. There was sand, and we had black feet. We had to clean it ourselves.
- The kitchen was very ill equipped. Basic dishes was missing, as well as a tea towel.
To end with a positive remark: Erdal, the host, was really great!! He always reacted quickly to every message and was very friendly.

My family and I (total 3 of us) had a wonderful stay at this apartment. It is in a historical building and very close to all the major tourist attractions. It’s about a 10 minute walk to the Aya Sofia and Blue Mosque. There are many restaurants, cafes and supermarkets just a few minutes walk away. Communication with the host was very smooth and he kindly arranged a private minibus to collect us from the airport. The apartment is clean and very comfortable. We will definitely book again next time we visit Istanbul.

We had a perfect apartment although it was a short stay. Everything was complete for a family of 4. The entire apartment was clean, neat and tidy. The bed linens and towels with fragrance, fresh and clean. We cool cook simple meals for the kids. There was microwave and kettle. All utensils were clean. We had no problem checking and out. Erdal and his family were wonderful host. The location is perfect. Nothing to worry about. All cafes, shops, restaurants and touristic places are so close by. Thank you for having us. Definitely would like to return. Highly recommended.

description: Cosy flat waiting for you

reviews.text:
The location is perfect, the area is great, the owner is the best. The house was clean, comfortable, and beautiful. The view from the window is just magical. Near cafes, restaurants, shopping center, Bazaar, metro, Metrobus, ferryboat, other transport stops. We easily and quickly reached Fatih, Galata tower, Hagia Sophia and other attractions. In the Kadıköy, too, a lot of interesting and beautiful. The Internet worked perfectly. And the best thing is the owner, a modern, kind and interesting person. I recommend 10/10.
Konumu mükemmel, alan harika, sahibi en iyisidir. Ev temiz, rahat ve güzeldi. Pencereden görünümü sadece büyülü. Kafeler, restoranlar, alışveriş merkezi, Çarşı, metro, Metrobüs, feribot, diğer ulaşım duraklarının yakınında. Fatih, Galata Kulesi, Ayasofya ve diğer cazibe merkezlerine kolayca ve hızlı bir şekilde ulaştık. Kadıköy'de de çok ilginç ve güzel. İnternet mükemmel çalıştı. Ve en iyi şey sahibi, modern, nazik ve ilginç bir kişidir. Ben tavsiye 10/10.
Расположение идеальное, район отличный, владелец самый лучший. Дом был чистым, уютным и красивым. Вид из окна просто волшебный. Рядом кафе, рестораны, торговый центр, базар, метро, Метробус, паром, другие остановки транспорта. Мы легко и быстро добрались до Фатиха, Галатской башни, собора Святой Софии и других достопримечательностей. В Кадыкее тоже много интересного и красивого. Интернет работал отлично. А самое лучшее-это хозяин, современный, добрый и интересный человек. Я рекомендую 10/10

This is a good, comfortable flat. It is a slightly downhill walk from Acıbadem metro station (good when walking home tired on a hot day) in a quiet residential area. There is even a skyline view, if you like that. :)
Caner is also an excellent host! Very responsive

Easy check in and out, clean home with all the amenities in working condition. Caner has welcomed us warmly, was easy to reach out and very responsive. We had a small issue with the Wi-Fi connection but Caner resolved it quickly. Recommended.

This is one of the coziest flats I’ve ever lived in, very pretty and clean, just 10 minutes walk from a huge mall where you can find literally everything and 10 minutes from the nearest subway station. It takes around 30 mins to get to the city centre. The location is very good, a very quiet neighbourhood with lovely cafes and coffee shops nearby (there’s a bakery right next to the entrance to the building, check it out, their desserts and pastry is out of this world). Caner is a very attentive guest who makes sure you really feel at home.

Caner's place is equipped with all necessary amenities, and its location is perfect. Caner is a very helpful and communicative host, he helped us during check-in and he was very responsive to all of our questions. I definitely recommend staying at his place!

description: Apartment is located in a very central location in Beyoglu district and 5 minutes walking distance from the famous Taksim square. Istiklal street, where there are many shops, cafes, restaurants and bars are located, is also in 5 minutes walking distance from the apartment. There are many convenient stores and amenities nearby where you can buy your provisions. Apartment is tastefully furbished and comfortable including fully equipped kitchen. However, there is no elevator in the building

reviews.text: Nice location, good internet, tv never worked. Small room. Comfy bed. Bathroom smells really bad.

Great place, great communication, great host, the apartment close to taksim square and metro station less than 4 minutes walk .. very clean apartment I like everything about it, i will definitely book it again

The host were really good people and tried to help us with everything.
The apartment was good to the value although the apartment was a bit small,but it was in a really good location, very close to everything, street food , main shopping area at Istanbul , super markets , banks , everything was a 2 minutes walk away.
We surely recommend :)
Great location near Taksim square, clean and tidy rooms, and helpful staff, especially Hakan who was available to help whenever I needed anything

Omg this is the worst place i have ever stay in, I could not imagine that there is a place where everything is horrible, very dirty bed , there was blood under the blanket, the last day there was no water at all, very very bad smell , omg thanks God because it was just for 2 nights, i cant say anything good about this place so please don’t take a room in this place even if its free

description:
Levent Apart is located in the Levent district of Istanbul, which is full of plazas and shopping malls. It is within walking distance to Kanyon, Özdilek and Metrocity shopping malls. Levent Apart is within walking distance to the Metro Transportation network and bus stops. You can easily travel within the city thanks to its proximity to the transportation network.
There is a washing machine in the apartment. Smart TV, Netflix, Youtube, Wifi are available.

reviews.text: Very comfortable place. Very clean and Serkan was very helpful and responsive. I definitely recommend the place. The area around is crowded and streets are small but there is plenty of parking in the mall which is a couple of minutes away walking. Will definitely come back here!

Hakan is a very good host. The flat was very clean and nice. There are 2 air conditioners work very good. Hakan met us on the reception, and provided keys to the room very fast. There is big mall near the hotel + metro station. Very comfortable location. I recommend to choose Hakan!

The flat was great, spacious and super clean and has all the necessary items you need at home. The flat location was great near markets, shop, restaurants and public transport.
Host Serkan made my first time visit to Istanbul super easy with his advice about places, locations and best way to reach them.

Nice neat place. Very convenient as near my office. The area is a bit congested though and could be tough for people with disability to access as there are steep climbs around the place and stairs to get in.
Serkan was a great host. Responsive and flexible. The size was perfect for me and everything that one needs was provided.
Hakan and his brother was really helpful. They were really friendly. The place was as in the photos. I had enjoyed staying in there.

description: Hello! Our apartment is located on the ground floor of our building. Our central location is within walking distance of Istanbul's most popular historical, cultural and tourist attractions such as the Blue Mosque, Hippodrome Square, Hagia Sophia (SS. Sergius ve Bacchus), Topkapı Palace, the Egyptian (Spice) Bazaar, the Golden Horn and many others. Just a few minutes' walk from the apartment's door are the tram and train stations, offering rapid and easy transportation to all parts of Istanbul.

reviews.text: Konumu gayet iyiydi. Oda düzenli ve temizdi. Açıklamada belirtilenlerin hepsi mevcuttu. 2 gün 4 kişi konakladık. Fiyatına göre konforu gayet iyiydi. Temiz ve düzenli olmasından çok memnun kaldık. Etraf gürültülü ve rahatsız edici değildi. Bununla ilgili bir problem yaşamadık. Sadece banyo giderinden biraz koku geliyordu ve su birikiyordu. Bunun dışında konaklama çok iyiydi. Her şey için teşekkür ederiz. Tercih edecek arkadaşlara tavsiye ediyorum. Konumu itibariyle neredeyse tüm çevreyi yürüyerek dolaşabilirsiniz. Araç park alanı tam önünde bulunmuyor biz aracımızı arka sokağa park ettik. Aracı olanlar bunu dikkate alsın. Banyo için havlu sabun mevcuttu. Mutfakta aradığınız her ürün mevcuttu. Çay su kahve için de ikramlar bırakılmıştı. Yastık çarşaf yorgan tümüyle mevcuttu. İşletme sahibiyle iletişim iyiydi. Giriş yaparken hiç zorlanmadık. Kalacak olanlara tavsiye ediyoruz.

One of the best places I’ve stayed in during my visit to Istanbul 🤍
I came from Canada, and honestly this place made me feel completely comfortable and at home from the first day. The apartment was extremely clean, modern, well organized, and had everything needed for a relaxing and enjoyable stay. The furniture was comfortable, the atmosphere was peaceful, and every small detail showed care and professionalism.
The location was absolutely perfect — close to restaurants, cafés, markets, and public transportation, which made moving around Istanbul very easy and convenient. The neighborhood was beautiful, safe, and quiet, perfect for both families and travelers looking for comfort and peace.
What made the experience even better was the excellent communication and hospitality. Everything was clear, smooth, and welcoming from beginning to end. You can really tell that the host cares about the guests and wants them to have the best experience possible.
I truly enjoyed my stay here and
Great spot only a few minutes walk to the main attractions. Easy check-in, quiet spot and spacious. No issues at all during my stay
4 gün kaldık ve muhteşem konumda ve harika bir evde kaldık. tam bir ev ortamında huzurlu ve güvendeydik. ev sahibi özellikle çok ilgiliydi. tekrar geldiğimde kalacağım bir yer
Görsellerle aynı, temiz bir oda ve güzel bir muhit. Çok memnun kaldık.

description:
Sultanahmet area
Grand Bazaar - 7 minutes walking distance
Sultanahmet Mosque - 11 minutes walking distance
Sultanahmet Square - 11 minutes walking distance
Ground cistern - 12 minutes walking distance
Hagia Sophia - 13 minutes walking distance
Egypt Bazaar - 17 minutes walking distance
Topkapı Palace - 19 minutes walking distance
Çemberlitaş Historical Bath-8 minutes walking distance

reviews.text:
We loved this hotel a lot. Very great price for what you get- room was exaclty like in photos, we had access to free coffee in the lobby, bed was really comfy.
The only thing we disliked were the very thin walls. And the water had a strong smell-so i would recommend bringing bottled water to brush your teeth. The shower was a bit dirty. The hotel is located in the hill area, so be prepared to do a lot of walking up and down the hill.
The workers in the lobby were very kind and welcoming- they gave us a lot of great advice for the things to do and were ready to help us 24/7.
I would definitely recommend staying here.

Great location. Close to all tourist spots and great restaurants. Clean rooms and comfortable beds. Great thing about this stay is the lift/elevator for getting up to higher levels. Believe me, if you have stayed in other hotels in Istanbul you will know most times you have to carry your suitcase up. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Always ready to help you and available by phone or texting to answer any questions. There is a receptionist in the lobby all night, there is always someone at front desk. Very safe location for tourists who don't know city well or at all. I was able to communicate with staff in English at all times. Recommend this location well, great value!

Address is actually no. 50., but easy enough to find. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Room was squeaky clean and just like the pictures. Shower was really good. Elevator was a bonus. Staff were very nice as they organised a cab for us to get to the airport upon our request. Shower gel and shampoo were changed daily, only thing was that they were in satchets. A lot of points of interest are close by making this a very ideal location.

The room was very cozy and clean, exactly like in the photos listed. The host was amazing and helped us get to the location, since the roads are very complicated after a 10 hours roadtrip. Everything is very close to the location, you only need to walk around 20 minutes to get anywhere, like the Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia, etc. Leave your car at home if you don't want to lose one hour on 8 kilometers. Otherwise, everything was according to the explanations and beyond. Will definitely come back

We had a really lovely stay at Ahmet’s hotel. The hotel is easily walkable to all the main sites (approx. 10 mins) and incredibly close to the metro (approx. 5 mins) but still feels quite private and away from the hussle and bussle. Reception is open 24/7 so late check-in is possible. The reception staff were really helpful and chatted us through the main sites on day 1 and around for recommendations if required. Also will arrange transfers if required both to and from the airport at a competitive price. Will agree with other reviews that the walls were quite thin but that didn’t really bother us. Overall a wonderful stay and fantastic value for money. Thanks Ahmet and team!

description:
The apartment is on the 4th floor of a historical building at Galata.

Due to the fact that the building is a historical heritage, there is no elevator available in the building. For details, our guest services will be more than happy to assist you.

A paid multi-storey car park is available just 50 meters away from the property .

reviews.text:
While the room was fine, it is overpriced, not the one that is shown in the photos, and all done quite unprofessionally. The instructions for check-in are unclear, they don’t tell you where to go, and there are Meroddi Hotels all over Galatta. I assume this is done intentionally so they can put you in a number of different places - quite dishonest. When I tried to contact the number suggested in their instructions to clarify, there was no response via Whats-App (as directed) or SMS. Response time the next day was also very slow and not helpful.
The unit I was given was not the one pictured and described.
The listing says there is a tumble dryer in unit, which there is not. This was the whole reason I took this room, to do some laundry with specific care instructions.
For this price, this was a huge disappointment. You can easily get cleaner, more comfortable, homier accomodations with complimentary breakfast and honest hosts for half the price in Istanbul.

The airbnb is best located. In my opinion there is no better location for a vacation in Istanbul. The Apartment is very clean and the staff friendly. Since there are only two little windows it was very stuffy. The kitchen could have been better equipped. But for the price and location a very good place to stay.
The apartment is small but well equipt. The AC was strong and great. It looks exactly as the pictures show. Great location, strong value, cute.

Great location. The apartment was close to Galata tower and great shopping areas but on a quiet charming street away from the noise. Would recommend booking with this host! They were super accommodating and even helped us getting a taxi upon leaving.

This is a hotel. It was a pleasure to have the amenities of a hotel like breakfast included, daily cleaning service and 24 hour reception. The WiFi was pretty poor though which made taking work calls quite a struggle.

description:
Dear customers, our apartment has a private bathroom, kitchen, bedroom
you have a private entrance to your own apartment
everything needed in a home is available.

reviews.text: The overall experience was good. I didn't meet Musa but his brother Emir, who was there to let me in. He was friendly and discrete during my stay and offered his help with a few things. The room was like the photos so I was totally satisfied with the studio considering the price. It was quite clean but I could smell something unpleasant during my whole stay, the source of which I couldn't track in the room. The bedsheets, pillowcase and hand/feet towels were clean but I could really use an extra whole-body towel for the shower. There were two windows which allowed the air to ventilate the room quite nicely but the curtains could be bigger and thicker to block the sun better. One thing I would suggest is to include shower gel in the bathroom and some drinkable water. The location of the place was in a walkable distance to the Taksim Square which was important to me and the area was quiet for most of the time. In general, I would suggest Musa's accommodation to other travelers.

Fantastic quality of stay for its price. The room was very cozy (with very comfortable bed) and super clean, wifi worked well, no noise/smells. The host was super friendly and responsive - I was able to book and check in on the same day. The location is very close to Taksim square and very safe, lots of restaurants and shops. I would definitely stay here again if I visit Istanbul again!

Pros: Location, view, shower, air con
Cons: WiFi barely works or not at all. Electric goes out alot making refrigerator unusable. He can turn electric back on if you message him. Hot water goes out but you can message him to turn on. Kitchen poorly stocked, things broken and dirty. Linen is very low budget scratchy, has holes, thread bare and misshapen. Local hostels have better linen. Room was dirty when I arrived, no cleaning matterials provided and have to give consent to clean a bunch or times in the same day. Security wasn't comforting. He knows when you leave/return and a bit too attentive in that regard. I found the keys to the whole hotel left on the banister outside of my room very early one morning (500am). He told me not to bother using the locks on my door because he was watching out. Alot of communication required just to use the space. I prefer a smooth stay and generally have long stays without contacting the host. This stay required daily contact and if I asked for everything in the listing, I would have been down right annoying, so I made the most of it.
I love Istanbul so the trip wasn't wasted but I wouldn't recommend this accommodation.

Musa is a great guy with a big heart and he will do everything to make you feel welcome and at home. The room was quiet, clean, warm and comfortable and in a very good location; and there are local shops and restaurants nearby. Cant go wrong with the price and the value. Great Value for money.
I would absolutely recommend you to stay here. Thank you Musa

Unfortunately, I didn't meet Musa, but his brother Emir was there. They were totally accessible and responsive. The studio was spacious and clean. Although it was on the third floor without an elevator, it was worth it for the price. Classic old but enough appliances in the kitchen. Thank you both.

description:
Our family-friendly comfortable apartments in Sisli, Istanbul, meet all the needs to make you feel at home. Our staff on duty is at your service from 10:00 to 22:00. There is 24 hour active security system and cameras for your safety. A comfortable accommodation experience awaits you with the comfort of an elevator in our apartments, which offer city views or the peace of calm streets.

*Note: If the dates you are looking for are not available, please message us :)

reviews.text: Very clean. I have very high requirements for cleanliness, the cleaning lady comes to my house three times a week. It was so clean, fresh and comfortable. There is everything you need for a comfortable life. Near a steakhouse, a fruit and water shop, 5 minutes walk to the metro.

I've stayed for 2 weeks in this wonderful apartment and it was a great experience.
The check in was on time, the place was clean and tidy. The studio is super comfortable and well-lit. I felt extremely safe in the neighborhood and I had an easy access to everything.
Enes, Alper's assistant, was super welcoming and nice. He always checked in, in case I needed anything and offered his help.
I highly recommend it!

The best place we stayed in Istanbul! Excellent and thoughtful design, comfortable bed and good furniture, a beautiful terrace with a great view, where you can spend a romantic evening. Despite the location of the apartment, there was no problem with parking. We will be happy to return to this apartment again:)

I had a great stay at Alpers apt. his assistant Enes was incredibly helpful with anything I needed. The apt had a cleaning service which was great for me as I had chosen to stay for a recovery time after surgery. The balcony was great for breakfast and fresh air. The area has amazing restaurants and cafes. This is a quiet and safe area with so much to do in walking distance. The metro is also super close if you want to get around quicker. I highly recommend it.

Definitely the most amazing apartments in Istanbul. I felt like home, the host was super responsive and helpful.
I will 100% return again, because the flat was really awesome - large bed, great shower and cozy little terrace for working and enjoying the sun

reviews.text:
It was a very good stay!
The apartment is very large, clean and comfortable, it has absolutely everything for a comfortable stay.
Excellent central location!
And Berkan is a really friendly and responsive host!
Thank you...

Positives : Location is very central and perfect to walk around in the area. The room itself is quite large.
The negatives are quite major for me, The place acts as a dance studio, and it is constant noise from music and dancing and not to mention other people who will use the only bathroom. Upon arrival the host let me know that he has lessons 3 times a week in the early evening and on occasion there are some during the day. What is actually meant out of 6 days I was there (one day arrived late evening), for 5 days there were lessons throughout the whole days and evenings. one evening people left at 11 pm!It is not an airbnb, it is a dance studio that has 2 rooms to rent. I mentioned that my friend will stay with me for a couple of nights and the owner wanted more $, where is the refund then for constant noise? The host has his belongings in one of the rooms, one day I was out and someone was in the room, same thing happened to the other guest. You are just $, no care about experience

Berkan is a great host, he was always there for me when I needed. he was so caring to me and my needs. the roomis clean, fresh and full of daylight. there lots of cafes and bars near the house and it was an amazing experience for me to stay there. and I have to tell living in a house with two gorgeous cats, listening tango and watching people dancing in tango was unforgettable for me. thank you berkan !

Konumu harika, ev aynı zamanda dans stüdyosu olduğu için şanslıysanız tango dersi de izleyebilirsiniz 😊 Berkan’ın iletişimi çok iyi, ihtiyacım olduğunda çekinmeden danışabildim. Kesinlikle öneriyorum 👌

The best place for living. Very nice location in Moda, there are a lot of cafes around, nice park, not far to ferry and metro. Room was so nice and comfortable. Berkan is so nice, kind and polite owner. It was a pleasure for me to stay in his apartments.

reviews.text: My wife and I spent 4 nights here and enjoyed every minute. Barbaros was very accommodating and always had an alternate contact available if he was not on site - otherwise he was only a phone call away. He and his merry band - including the adjacent restaurant staff - were always helpful and pleasant to deal with. Barbaros offers a 10% discount on meals at specified locations and generously treated us to tea and wine on several occasions. The room is just as pictured spacious, clean and comfortable. There is Sat TV as well as pre-taped movies available. The fridge is well stocked with water and the facilities were superb (other than an annoying drip in the toilet which is easily fixed by jiggling the flusher or turning off the inlet access). This room is in the heart of the restaurant district so there are numerous locations to chow down - most offering outdoor seating. One thing to mention, for the light sleeper you may need to keep the window closed periodically - this is an authentic real neighbourhood - there are noises, parties, passersby, the daily calling to prayer (5 times - one being at precisely 430AM), and conversational discussions. All these distractions add to the atmosphere and make you feel truly immersed in what Istanbul has to offer. A great stay, great host!!

The time we spent with Barbaros/at his apartement/his restaurant was awesome: he is a very friendly person and communication with him was fast, easy and always helpfull. The big room is as you can see on the pictures, the bed is compfortable, the TV huge, the bathroom clean and the little kitchen well-equipped and the location of it close to good food/historic sites/easy shopping etc. The food at his restaurant is also really nice.
All in one: definitly a recommendable place to stay when you want to discover the amazing city Istanbul!

The space is as depicted in the pictures. Anna the lady who stays at and attends to renters is friendly and approachable, she speaks little English but we pretty much managed to communicate with gestures and such. Anything more complicated can be taken up with either Barbaros or his cousin Ali who are both often at the common area on the ground floor in the evenings. They are also very forward with tips and ideas about what you can do or where you can go. The apartment is located above their restaurant. We loved the homey feel of not just the apartment but the neighbourhood. The hustle and bustle of the area (many shops all around) allows you to experience life like a local. On weekends the business of the area can be felt well into late night (1/2 a.m.) and you'll be able to hear the revelry of the restaurant guests. Didn't bother us as we felt it added to our experience but if you are looking for the quiet and sterile hotel-like environment then this place is not for you. This is also not suitable for a person with mobility issues, access to the apartment is via a narrow spiral staircase and although it is near the tram station and Grand Bazaar, it is a good 8-10 min uphill walk. That said, it is easy and cheap to get uber to come to the road just by the apartment if walking is not your thing. If you do stay here, do have breakfast at the cosy small cafe (Kumkapi Our Bakery) just opposite the apartment building. The guys running it are really sweet and accommodating and the cooked breakfasts are really good. All in all we really loved our stay here. We came as strangers but left behind a group of friends who sent and waved us off as our van pulled away!

This is without a doubt the best Airbnb experience we've had!

Barbaros is a tremendous host - greeted us with Turkish tea when we arrived at 8AM in the morning, showed us the room, gave us an Istanbul transit card to take public transportation, showed us the way to attractions we wanted to visit, recommended us wonderful restaurants, and even showed us how to make Turkish coffee.

The location is perfect - 5 minute walk from the tram, 10 minute walk to tons of attractions and stores in the Sultanahmed area, including but not limited to: Hagia Sofia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, Basilica Cistern, Cemberlitas Hamami, ...

The room is exactly as photographed, very spacious and nice, private bathroom, heating and air conditioning, coffee machine, turkish coffee, and free water in the fridge, power adapters so we can charge our electronics, 3D TV preloaded with thousands of new 2D and 3D movies.

We would definitely stay here again the next time we visit Istanbul!

If you plan to visit Istanbul, I strongly reccomend to choose this apartment and enjoy the communication with Barbaros.
The room matches all the specifications and photos from the app. Nice location, clean and stylish. Cool restraunt in the building and great cafe (for breakfast) in front of the entrance. Was a bit noizy in the evening, because the street has active trafic if people, but no still no problem for sleeping.
One of the most positive and remarkable things about the trip was the Barbaros’s attitude and hospitality - truly an example of a local that meets newcomers in the city. He was very helpful, described all the peculiarities of the city, of places of interest, shared his knowledge about every point or issue we were intrested in. For me it was clear that it all goes by heart!
Thank you Barbaros! If one day I come back to Istanbul, I text you in facebook :)
Sincerely, Grigory!

description:
We are at your service to offer you a different holiday by combining the whispers of pine and tangerine trees on the banks of the Agva Göksu River, the magnificent scent of the linden tree, with the chirping sounds throughout the day.

We carried our past dreams and family heirlooms to Park Mandalin.

We tried to create a place where you can feel at home and receive warm and friendly service for 12 months in our hotel, which we opened by preserving the natural texture.

Very nice and clean place, very helpful host, I’d recommend this place
