description: Hello, we are Bahar and Şaban. We have been hosting you since 2020 to provide you with a perfect Istanbul experience. This flat is right in the heart of Cihangir (innovative district of Istanbul), which has a very central location. Here is the list of things you can do by walking 10 minutes from the apartment :) You can be in Galata Port, Taksim Square, Istiklal Street, take a tram to Hagia Sophia or Topkapi Palace, enjoy the Bosphorus with Turkish coffee, hang out in innovative bars.

reviews.text:
Overall, we had a pleasant stay, but there were a few areas that could be improved.
The apartment was well located with easy access to transport and local amenities. The check-in process was smooth and your communication was prompt and helpful.
However, the noise level was quite high, especially at night. This affected our quality of sleep. Also, the mattress provided in the apartment was not very comfortable. It felt soft and collapsed under our weight, making it difficult to get a good night's sleep.
Despite these problems, we appreciated the cleanliness of the apartment and the facilities provided. The kitchen was well equipped and the overall ambience of the apartment was pleasant.
We hope you find this feedback constructive and will consider making the necessary improvements.
Thank you very much for your hospitality and we wish you all the best.

Her şeyden önce eve girdiğimiz ilk andan son güne kadar sürekli iletişimi kesmeyen bir ev sahibi vardı ve bu durum bizi daha güvende daha huzurlu hissettirdi. Evle ilgili konuşulacak söylenecek çok şey var. Eve girer girmez fotoğraflardan çok daha da güzel olduğunu görebiliyorsunuz. Hiçbir şey eksik değil aksine ihtiyacınız olan her şey mevcut hatta fazlasıyla mevcut. Ev sizin için özel hazırlanmış ve sunulan ikramlar bile mutlu etti. Bu da daha keyifli zamanlar geçirmemize yardımcı oldu. Evdeki temizlik, konfor, konum, iletişim her şey 10/10 olarak değerlendirebiliriz. Hiçbir şekilde kendilerini bile rahatsız etmedik çünkü evde her şeye ulaşabilmek çok kolay oldu. Kendilerine buradan da teşekkür ederim. Çünkü çok güzel 1 hafta geçirdik. Tekrar İstanbul’da olacak olursam bu ev benim için ilk seçenek olacak. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

Saban's place was excellent overall. The host is very responsive. The self check in is super easy. The location is really great with a grocery store and multiple restaurants and cafes within a 5 minute walk. About an 8 min walk to the metro. Bed is comfortable and kitchen is fully stocked. We were able to cook Thanksgiving dinner in it. Great shower with hot water! We would definitely stay here again.

The place is located literally at the center of Cihangir, the best neighborhood to my consideration. Grocery, cafes n restaurants, hair-cut, hospital, police station... everything is within the stone throw distance, literally.
Ideal place for moving anywhere in Istanbul. Public transports- metro, bus, tram, ferry all are very close to this place (5-10 min at best). Taksim square, Galataport, galata tower, istiqlal street, Karakoy, Besiktas are near proximity.
The apartment is very suitable for single or couple and both short and long term. The place is at the first floor, so you never get trouble carrying heavy luggage. We found the place very clean and tidy. The hosts maintained and arranged each and everything you need. They also tagged (in english) on things so you never get lost using equipments like- washing machine etc.
Bahar and Saban are very very caring hosts. Remained all time connected. They are so kind and so human. Check in and check out was super easy.
The value for money was great. Our five days staying was unforgettable. We felt happy, healthy and safe.
Wish to stay again.
I definitely recommend everyone.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this remarkable apartment in Istanbul, and I must say, it exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I stepped through the door until the end of my stay, I was thoroughly impressed by the accommodation, its location, and the exceptional hospitality provided by the hosts.
The amenities provided were top-notch. The kitchen was well-equipped with all the necessary appliances and utensils, making it easy for me to prepare my own meals whenever I desired. The selection of coffee and teas at their place was good too.Situated in a lively neighborhood, I had easy access to a plethora of local restaurants, cafes, and shops. The convenience of having the city's famous attractions within walking distance was a major advantage.
Bahar and her husband are super responsive to any inquiries or concerns. They make you feel comfortable and assured that you are in good hands :)

description: Hello, I am Yusuf. I offer you the opportunity to stay in my historical apartment right across from the Galata Tower, which was built by the Byzantine Emperor Justinian in 507 - 508 AD. You will feel the comfort of both historical and modern life in the apartment. At the same time, the region is within walking distance to popular places such as Hagia Sophia, Sultan Ahmet and Galata Port Taksim. An unforgettable stay awaits you, I will help you with airport transfers

reviews.text:
The place looks EXACTLY like the pictures. It’s a Loft stay with a beautiful view and worth every penny spent!
The stay is on the 5th floor without an elevator, however Yusuf was extremely helpful and carried our large bag all the way up.
The bedroom does not have AC but we travelled in Sept and kept the windows open during night and it was okay, infact got a bit chilly on some nights.
There is a 24/7 restaurant downstairs at the enterance and a supermarket right across. The street is very popular among younger crowd and gets loud during night. However we used to be tired from the day and mostly slept through it all, even with our windows open.
The washroom is small.
The apartment is self sufficient in every way. We found everything to use from an empty bottle of water to coffee maker and a wine bottle opener.
It’s not a luxury stay but a truly remarkable stay with a Magnificent view of Galata Tower !! If walking up 5 floors is not a problem then don’t think twice before booking.

This cozy flat is located with an amazing view of the Galata Tower, an awesome daily viewing experience in itself. From the moment you breathlessly walk into the apartment and see the view, quickly you'll realize that you are in a very special place. Yusuf and his team are extraordinary in their communication and desire to make sure that you have a comfortable experience all around. They offered transfers from the airport at a reasonable rate as well as help getting up and down the staircases with our luggage. The apartment itself is basic but nice, and the air conditioning is absolutely awesome! It was a gigantic relief to come back to Yusuf's apartment at the end of a very hot day touring around Istanbul! I definitely recommend this apartment and think it is a very good value for what you get! Thank you for the lovely stay Yusuf and good luck with your Airbnb sir! And please keep up the amazing hospitality, service, and communication, it is very unique to find that in Turkey! 5⭐s

Excellently located in a vibrant, central area with stunning views that lived up to the listing photos.
The staircase wasn’t mentioned in the booking details, but the host handled it graciously , arranging help with our luggage at check-in. Overall, the host was friendly, responsive, and proactive, offering useful local recommendations when asked.
A couple of things worth flagging for future guests: managing bags down the stairs at checkout was quite challenging, particularly as we had to leave in the middle of the night for an early flight - this could genuinely be a safety concern for anyone travelling with heavy luggage. The bedroom blinds don’t fully cover the sides of the windows, allowing early morning light to seep through, which disrupted my sleep noticeably. The bathroom also felt rather makeshift - though this may simply be a reflection of what’s available at this price point in Istanbul.
That said, the views, location, and hospitality made for an enjoyable stay overall.​

Evin konumu ve manzarası mükemmel.Taksim, tarihi yarımada gibi merkezi ve turistik yerler yürüyüş mesafesi.Bölge çok popüler olduğu için gece gürültü olur mu diye endişelenmiştik ama hiç gürültü duyulmuyormuş.Mutfak malzemeleri de 2-3 kişilik konaklama için son derece yeterli.Yusuf Bey de ilgili ev sahibi, rahatlıkla ulaşabildik.Gerçi evle ilgili hiç bir sorun olmadığı için pek de temasa geçmemiz gerekmedi ama giriş çıkış günlerimizde hep önceden yakınlardaydı, valizlere de yardımcı oldu sağolsun, merdiven biraz zorlu bir etap olabiliyor :) Benim için tek sorun banyoda bir duşakabin olmamasıydı, belki fotoğraflarda bellidir de ben fark etmemişimdir.Her duş sonrası banyo sular içinde kaldığı için vileda yapmak gerekiyor.Ama manzara için viledaya değer:)

Pros & cons:
Let me just say that this location is PERFECT!!!! The view is absolutely stunning and the surrounding restaurants and cafe’s people are fighting for the view you get from your window. The restaurants in the area are FANTASTIC!! We booked this place the same day and stayed for 2 nights. Yusuf was a great host and communicated quickly when we needed him. He met us at check in and helped us carry our bags up which was super nice because the stairs were HELL!!
To be completely honest the stairs are insane to walk up and down for 2 fit-able bodied people. We would be dripping in sweat by the time we reached our door but it did feel like a great intense workout after eating all day. The shower and bathroom are uncomfortable to use and very small, there was no coffee, the Wi-Fi did not work the entire time we were there and the AC is in the living room only, not the bedroom so we ended up sleeping on the living room floor.
If the Wi-Fi was working and if the way up & down wasn’t so difficult, plus the other things I mentioned, this would be a definite 5 star place.

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this quiet, centrally located and safe place on the European side. You can reach the center or bus stops in 5 minutes, the ferry or Nişantaşı in 15 minutes by walking. 10 minutes to Taksim or Havataş by taxi.

Enjoy a simple, comfortable and safe stay in this centrally located quiet place. You can reach the center or bus stops in 5 minutes on foot, and the ferry and Nişantaşı in 15 minutes. Taksim and Havataş are 10 minutes away by taxi.

reviews.text:
Would prefer to give 6 out of 5 stars.
I had an absolutely wonderful stay at this beautiful, bright apartment. There is a lot of light shining through the large windows, the temperature kept warm inside (in Feb when it's still cold in Istanbul). The apartment is designed so beautifully and welcoming to any guests. It's spacious and clean. The place is well decorated and much better than the photos, it has everything you need and it’s perfect for long stays, because it’s near the transportation, near the services, offers speed internet so it’s perfect for those who work and travel.
The hosts Nesli and Damla, two nice sisters, are lovable, great with hospitality. They will make you feel at home and assist you with anything you need. They are well-spoken and polite at all times.
Bedroom was a comfortable medium size bed with soft bed sheets and closet space. Very comfortable mattress to sleep on, great night sleep. The neighborhood: easily walkable to plenty of restaurants, bars, book stores, markets, shops. Yet it's tucked away on a residential street so it's quiet at night.
Last but not the least, they have the most beautiful cat you've ever seen. Her name is Bonbon, the diva <3 , will not bother you, but will catch your attention easily.
This is the best Airbnb stay and experience I ever had, totally recommend, and definitely will come back.

Nice room to stay, the host was communicative. She was helpful in many things.
But I encountered two issues, she didn’t have a spare key, which was uncomfortable to ring the bell every time you come back, until the last day she gave me her key.
The second thing, is if you try to alternate your stay, the host will ask you to book again so you can pay the cleaning fee and service fee of airbnb. But I decided to go to the WEHOME Bleu Horizon hotel, same price but better quality.
The room is spacious, but wasn’t sparkling clean, you can notice dust between the bed and the wall, under the bed, as well as the pillow cover has a lot of cat’s hair, I had to cove the pillow with my T-shirt.
The location is in a hill, every time you go out, be prepared to climb the hill to come back to the room.
Besides all of that, everything went well, the host are always working, quite and nice.

Gul’s place is in a great location for Besiktas and all the bars, shops and restaurants. It’s an easy walk down the hill to the main street and then on to the ferry for access to the Asia side.
The bedroom is clean and tidy and nice and warm- a cosy bed for a good night’s sleep!
I booked quite last minute and Gul and Damla were both accommodating and helpful with my stay.
The herbal tea was tasty and definitely good for my health- thanks!

her şey fotoğrafta gösterildiği gibiydi, iletişim konusunda hızlı ve her konuda yardımcı oldu. Ev temiz düzenliydi. Rahat ettirmeye çalıştı. Herhangi bir sorun yaşamadan, tercih edilecek bir konaklama.
Ev sahibi çok güler yüzlü. Evin konumu merkezi, ev temiz ve rahat. Benim beklentilerimi karşıladı.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text: From the first moment I got to Fatih’s place, I felt right at home. He had recently renovated the living room and kitchen so the photos did not justify his place. He had a new dining table, four dining chairs, two brand new sofas, new oven and all the kitchen utensils you need (just no microwave which I don’t use anyway). The apartment is walkable to many restaurants/bars/supermarkets, but be warned due to the Istanbul terrain, it is on a hill and on the fourth floor of the building with no lift. I stayed for a total of 9 nights, with my original booking for 6 nights. Fatih was very helpful, accommodating and nothing was too much to ask. He made me feel at ease at his place and even accommodated the extra nights my wife and I needed to stay there. It is without a doubt the best experience I have had in Istanbul and the best host I’ve had the pleasure staying with. I cannot recommend his place or the Besiktas area enough, just as mentioned it isn’t fit for OAP or disabled people

It’s located in one of the vibrant, hip neighborhood where you are overwhelmed to try all the foods and desserts around. Most important, I felt super safe walking around at night. It is a bit of a walk on the hill as well as stairs, but that’s the price you get for the view. This apartment has great both front and back view; one facing huge trees from the park with random cats and birds on them 😆 and one facing Bosporus. The house is really clean with fresh linens and well organized. The host and his brother both were truly nice and kind people. I really felt I knew them personally. I genuinely appreciate their hospitality!! It certainly made my stay much warmer! ☺️

The double view to Abbasağa park and to the Bosphorus is worth it! Watching the ferry traffic from the bed is amazing.
Typical old Beşiktaş house, you don’t feel a tourist there which is good.
The neighborhood is safe and with the windows closed you keep out the noise, although you are in the very middle of everything that I really like.
The flat could have been prepared better, communication was difficult as no-one spoke any English, so we used google translate.
After the initial minor issues the stay was seamless, and the host was very flexible with checkout and re checkin times as I stayed 2 different smaller periods with a break in between.

I had a wonderful stay in Istanbul! I spent a lot of time searching for the right place, and this was exactly what I was looking for. Fatih was an exceptional host—kind, welcoming, responsive, and always ready to help. The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described, and everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out. I personally think that the accommodation is better than the photos :).
Fatih’s hospitality made my trip even more enjoyable. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul. A well-deserved five stars!

Fatih’s place is in a great location, I’ll say that’s the selling point of the place. Easy access to public transport (bus, ferry, taxi) and good amount of restaurants, bars, coffee shops. Very close to busy areas but on a quiet road.
We had a comfortable stay, the place was clean and Fatih provides a great variety of amenities.
There are a couple of things that can make the place better and more comfy: the door in the kitchen where the rubbish is needs to be fixed, the shower head doesn’t stay in place so we had to hold it. Great water pressure! The AC in the living room is not enough to cool down the bedrooms ( hot summer days)
Overall we had a pleasant stay.

description:
IDENTITY VERIFICATION IS MANDATORY FOR EVERYONE.

NOT SUITABLE FOR GUESTS UNDER 18 YEARS OF AGE.


Our place is located in Kadıköy and each room has steel doors with security.
24-hour reception and free Wi-Fi are available.

Our place is within walking distance of shopping malls, bars, cafes and restaurants and close to transportation options.

Being close to metro, metrobus, Marmaray, ferry, bus and minibus stops provides easy access to all tourist attractions of Istanbul.

reviews.text: Very easy to find and check in, there was always someone friendly at the reception. The room is simple but nice and comfy. It’s like a hotel but without room service or cleaning. The location is great, less than 10 minutes walk to the ferry which takes you to the European side quickly. The apartment is surrounded by shops and restaurants and yet quiet (apart from an AC in the backyard). Good value for money. We recommend it!

Thank you for hosting us. We had an amazing stay.
Some good review points for other fellow travelers to take in:
-Yigit is a caring and very responsive person. We encountered some problems made by ourselves but Yigit was eager to solve it in good cooperation. You always will be welcomed in with a smile.
-The Airbnb is a really good price/quality ratio. The best one I have seen so far. It's room is spacious and the bed lays very comfortable. The interior is wonderful too.
- The location is absolutely superior. it's close to the ferry terminal and the bus station in Kadıköy. This makes many parts of Istanbul very reachable and saves you a lot of time traveling around during your stay. For cute restaurants just go out of the hotel and you're already basically in the best restaurant district in all of Istanbul.
-The Airbnb was very clean. No issues have been found during our stay.
I'm definitely recommending this place to stay in.

everything was as described, location is perfect and the room was perfectly clean.
Host and receptionists are really nice and caring.i will definitely be staying again

Wonderful place to stay, located right in the middle of the vibrant Kadikoy yet when you close your window there is no disturbance. Surrounded by restaurants and shops and banks, 10 minute walk from the metro and ferries, has everything you need. Well kitted out with a kettle, bar fridge and airconditioner, bathroom was great. The room is neat and quite modern, I definitely recommend it. Wifi was fast and Murad was extremely helpful and responded to queries and requests quickly and efficiently. I was very comfortable here.

We stayed at Yigit’s place in Kadikoy for 4 nights while visiting Istanbul. The airbnb is exactly as described. It is close to metro and ferry and buses. Overall, great however, there’s no washer/dryer or iron for guest use (although they were very very kind to make an exception and let us use their iron). Overall, well worth the price

description: The apartment building has a special location in the city, close to trade and shopping centers (Trump Towers and Cevahir mall), banks, cinemas, theaters and art centers. You can easily reach E5, one of the main transportation routes in Istanbul, metro and metrobus. Our facility has a washing machine, kitchen, microwave, oven, air conditioning, smart TV and refrigerator. Among the amenities offered are free Wi-Fi access and free parking.

reviews.text:
A very clean apartment.
Very cosy, with a small double bedroom, and a small-ish living room/kitchen space with two sofa-beds.
Very friendly staff at check in at ground floor reception.
Very close to Trump Towers, about 10 minutes walk from the nearest Metro.

The apartment is in a very convenient location, right next to Trump Tower mall and metro and bus stations. The building has 4 parking spaces to the left of the main entrance but before you arrive, it is a good idea to message them and let them know your arrival time so they can reserve it for you. You can also park on the street but it is very busy so unlikely to find a space. Don’t park at the car park next to the building. They tried charging us 700TL for 24hrs when in the mall it is 400TL( before I found the car park next to the building which is FREE like mentioned). The host was very responsive and messaged right away when reached. The only minus is that the apartment needs a little freshen up. It was clean but a little worn. We stayed for 2 ngts and for the purpose of our travel it was good enough! :)

Konaklamamız gayet sorunsuz ve güzel geçti. Yardımsever, güler yüzlü ve hızlı hizmet anlayışıyla günün 24 saati her ihtiyacımıza hızlı ve güleryüzlü hizmet sunuldu. Fiyat performans açısından çok iyi bir yer. Ev sıcacıktı genel temizliği iyiydi. Diğer bir kaç ufak sorun ise, dairemizde yan daireye bağlanan bir kapı vardı bu bizi rahatsız etti açıkcası. Ses izolasyonu malesef biraz zayıf. En çok üzen durum ise detaylı temizlik yapılmamıştı koltuk aralarında ve altlarında MAALESEF toz, pislik(mısır, yiyecek, saç telleri) ve çöpler vardı ama genel temizlik iyiydi. Tekrar konaklamaya geleceğiz ve aynı sorunları yaşamamayı diliyorum.

the apartment was not the same as it was shown in the photos, it was different, we made a reservation for three people and there was only one double bed and two sofas, we had to ask for an extra bed. Additionally, the little cleanliness was noticeable, especially in the bedding they smelled of sweat, we arrived very late and we had to sleep like that, but it was really disgusting and unpleasant

Konum olarak güzel. Apart otel şeklinde. Asansör var. Ev sahibi mesajlara hızlıca yanıt veriyor. Ama evdeki en büyük problem temizlikti. Sandalyeler ve koltuklar lekeliydi. Koltuklarda lekelerin yanında kırıntılar vs vardı. Bazı havlular ve yastıklar lekeliydi. Yenisini istedik. Her şeyden önemlisi temizlik bizim için çok önemli. Koltuklar değiştirilse iyi olur çünkü gerçekten eskiler. Her yere çarşaf sererek oturduk.

description:
The apartment is located in Kurtulus, a historic and cosmopolitan neighborhood in the heart of the city, surrounded by lots of cafes, bars, restaurants and markets. 15 minutes by walk to metro & bus stations, 25 minutes to Taksim, 20 minutes to Nisantasi. There are also Ferikoy Flea Market and Organic Bazaar nearby.

My home is located in Kurtuluş, a historic and colorful neighborhood. There are many cafes, bars, restaurants and grocery stores in the vicinity, and transportation is quite easy. I'm also close to the Flea Market and the Organic Market.

reviews.text: This is a house at the center area of Istanbul and it is convenient to go to Şişli and Nişantaşı. The house is very clean and very comfortable to live in. Leyla hnm has provided all necessary daily necessities and I am feeling like I am at my own home. The environment is the same as shown in the photo and real feeling is even better. Leyla hnm and her housemate are warm and kind and they are always willing to help. There is a cosy sofa in the room on which you could relax and read something peacefully. There are markets, cafe and other stores nearby which make your stay even more convenient. Suggest to try!

A great experience in every aspects. Host was very kind and helpful. House was very clean and organized. And for a person who values personal space, I had an extremely comfortable stay. I am happy to find a place I can stay on my trips to İstanbul in the future without any worries at all.
that was incredible! very kind and helpful host <3 very clean and comfortable, the best place in istanbul in 3 months here

Firstly, we liked the location of house and the modernity of room very much. The room was very clean and made us so comfortable. Special thanks to Leyla, who has been so sincere and warm throughout our stay :)

It was a really good to live at this place. I felt so cozy from my first day until last day of my trip. Location is not so far from metro station Osmanbey which located nearby with Taksim square and metro Taksim where you can arrive by bus from airport. And it's like 30 min walking from there to apartment. And 15-20 min on metro and a bit walking.
There are a lot of different cafes and restaurants where you can try national cuisine. And Leyla was super helpful and interested on my experience in Istanbul. She gave me so many good recommendations about places which I must have to see and try.
My room was clear and beautiful and It was so nice to come back there after long walking. And I definitely will be happy to stay there again If I will go to Istanbul again.

description:
Charming apartment in the heart of Istanbul. Just 2 minutes away from amazing restaurants, cafes, bars, shops, and so much more. Unbeatable location with Galata Tower, Istiklal Street and Galataport only minutes away. The Blue Mosque and Grand Bazaar are 20 min away.

Perfect for weekend getaway, work-from-home alternative, or cozy home base while exploring everything Istanbul has to offer.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Galateia Residence for 4 nights. It was exceptionally clean, comfortable and very spacious. The facilities were brilliant, especially the bathroom and the bed was very comfortable. The kitchen is well equipped and it’s very easy to find grocery shops nearly to stock up on basics. The air con works great. The only facility that could be improved in the future would be a smart tv / more international options for tv channels but obviously that’s not essential. We were very happy.
The place is in an excellent location, getting to any of the popular sights was very easy, with a metro stop and tram stop both very close and lots of good bars and restaurants within a short walking distance.
Having a staff member at the desk made everything very convenient and they were very friendly and helpful at all times.
Highly recommend!

Galatiea Airbnb went above and beyond. On my first day in Istanbul I suffered a freak accident and broke my foot. I was forced to search for an Aircast boot and “Yunus” at the front desk was indispensable in helping with translational services as well as networking to help find and deliver a suitable Aircast. Bravo Yunus!
The residence is ideally located approximately 300m from the Shishane metro station and Istikal street. The main entrance has a locking front door and the front desk is occupied 24/7. The apartment is as it appears in the photos. Very clean with a comfortable King sized bed. The apartment has ample room and a full sized kitchen with utensils. AC and wifi were excellent. Istanbul is a noisy city but our street was relatively quite overnight. Would whole heartedly recommend without hesitation and definitely would stay again if I return to Istanbul.

We loved our stay here! The Galateia team was very responsive and flexible with us. The apartment was as described and pictured; the bathroom was wonderful! Very central location with easy access to metro and near amazing spots like the Galata tower, Istikal street, etc. This is a great stay for the price!

We were extremely pleased with our stay at Galateia! The reception and staff were extremely friendly and responsive to any needs. The place was clean and accurate to the description. We had some wifi issues that they did their best to correct. The location is great, just steps say from Sishane metro stop, Istiklal street, with lots of great restaurants around. Thanks for a great stay!

Highly recommended. Exact to pictures. Host was very helpful and responsive. Receptionists were helpful too and tried their best to communicate using translation apps. Place was very clean and had all the amenities listed. Location is perfect and right in the middle of all the attractions (galata tower, istikal street, famous restaurants found in tiktok, etc). It is also near transport systems (trams, bus stations and metro).

description: In the center of Ortaköy, less than 300 meters from the Bosphorus and located in a quiet alley, the apartment is one of the few in the neighborhood, spacious living room and bedrooms, elevator in the building, secure, air conditioning in the living room.

reviews.text: Onder is a very good host and is responsive and communicative. His apartment is clean and and similar to the pictures. This apartment locate in a old neighborhood and is close-by local stores. Kitchen had the majority of appliances and cooking essentials. Bathroom was clean but the shower was not attached and you should take it by your hand and wash your body. Beds were clean and sheets were washed and smelled good.

Onder was an amazing host. He made sure we had everything for our stay. We came with our one year old and he bought us a high chair because he didn’t have one with no extra charge and he also bought us a box of formula so we have it ready for our son. He provided us with a baby bed as well. He was patient with us with our checkout as we had some problems finding the address. The house was spotless when we arrived 🥰 the decoration was also amazing and all appliances was there as listed. The only misunderstanding we had was the stairs. Even though the listing says no stairs we assumed that there would be no stairs at all but there was stairs at the entrance which made our stay a little hard with a buggy. And even though there is a lift it is very tiny to fit the buggy in it so we had to struggle a little but other than that everything was amazing the house is located in a very fun and beautiful area a few minutes walk from the sea and markets and also the mosque. The only thing I would advise if you are looking to book the house is that if you are planning to stay at the house more often than going out, being loud is a big issue. The listing specified about noise but we thought it meant for the night time but the neighbours are elderly people who do not appreciate any type of bigger noise including loud talking or tv noise or hoovering even in the afternoon so we had some trouble with our son being loud and us being 6 people was hard to keep the noise down but the landlord has dealt with the neighbours amazingly and efficiently.

Location was great. Accessible to shops, restaurants, tailor, bakery and plenty more. The owner needs to spend money on upgrading bathroom, kitchen and install A/C. Rooms were extremely hot. Bathroom tub is designed for a small child. Water temperature constantly went from cold to hot.

An excellent location to enjoy Istanbul night life and key attractions. The flat is very clean, airy, fresh and well decorated. Önder is very accommodating and welcoming. He was there for us when we arrived and even there when we left at 3 am for our flights and helped us with our luggage. Lift, smart tv, washing machine, fans and kitchen full size fridge made us feel like home. The coffee/ sheesha and breakfast tea cafes around the area gave us the real taste of the culture. The Blacktop Cafe is a must visit to enjoy unique drinks and amazing Sheesha and food. The sea shore is near and the mosque is a must see. The street market and food was great fun. Overall what an amazing experience thanks to Önder’s lovely flat.
Merci!!!

Amazing host , great and clean apartment, location is great near by bus station, all groceries shops and pharmacies are within walking distance, Önder was amazing host, he was there for any questions i had

description:
You can stay in a room in my centrally located jungle flat. The bed you will be staying in is a double bed.
It is 10-12 minutes away from all means of transportation (subway, marmaray, ferry, metrobus, bus, minibus). Text me for details <3

reviews.text:
Would recommend this host and apartment for anyone of any age or sex. Absolutely brilliant place, quite and peaceful sleep yet 5 minutes to shops restaurants and entertainment.
Clean, comfortable, brilliant wifi connection.
Arda is an amazing host and his place is super comfortable and cozy, well-located and has everything you need, whether for a short or long stay. Highly recommend!
Nice and clean room and public spaces. Good quiet location. Arda is a very kind and helpful host.

The location is fantastic with so many things to do and see nearby. The surroundings are incredibly beautiful and perfect for exploring. The room itself is quite spacious and comfortable, with a fan provided in case it gets too hot.Animal lovers will be delighted to meet the three friendly cats that add a charming touch to the place. Additionally, you can always make yourself a cup of tea and spend a cozy evening in the living room.

I felt at home, the host was very welcoming.
The accommodation is very comfortable and the surroundings are rich with cafes and attractions, I highly recommend this place to stay.

description:
Our Stunning 3 Bedroom Apartment up to 6 guests in a fantastic location only 5 - 6 minutes walking from the Galata Tower and only 4 minutes walking from the Galataport!

Our modern duplex apartment is located on the ground floor of a residential building. It has a cozy garden/patio which you can relax and also has a magnificent winter patio!

According to your demand we can arrange a transportation!

reviews.text:
We stayed at Mr. Behic’s place for a week and it was amazing. The positives are:
1) Location: Its situated in a nice quiet area but just around the corner is Taksim and is less than 8-10 min walk. What was so convenient about the location was the auto park which was next to the building.
The Appartment is also just a minute walk from many mini marts and cafes. Its also close to many nice areas that you can walk to.
2) Appartment: when you get in the place there is big living room , balcony opening to the private garden (which was AMAZING) from this balcony there are outdoor stairs leading to the bottom floor of the appartment. There is one bedroom upstairs with its own nice patio (so green) with a seating area. Also you have on this floor one bathroom and a kitchen equipped with what you will need. The layout and of the place was nice, clean, comfortable and spacious.
On the bottom floor you have a laundry room, 2 bedrooms (one of them had a bathroom). Both bedrooms downstairs had glass doors leading to the garden which was private. Also the biggest plus for us was the privacy you get here.
Rooms were spacious, comfortable beds and clean.
3) Communication: communication was quick and easy with the host who was really kind and patient with us contacting him so many times.
Overall our stay was amazing, pleasant and comfortable. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to be on a quiet street but very close to nice locations.

We have had a great stay at the property. Found the location easily. Check in was very smooth. We had a few inquiries that were answered by Behic promptly.. The duplex was as clean and as pictured. And AC was in all rooms thankfully.
I had mild inconveniences that can be overlooked and not a big deal, when I found it there was no coffee machine or microwave at the property. My mistake I should’ve checked the amenities list, instead of assuming they’re there, since it’s usually at any house. There was a kettle and all the other needed pots pans and plates. And a Turkish coffee dallah which was handy in the morning .
Location was really good. Walking distance to Galata, Taksim and Galata Port. Of course that area is hilly so you can expect some muscle work but taxis reach it, and it’s very doable. There’s also an elevator and a small garden that we didn’t use but it was a nice edition.
All in all it was a good experience, thanks Behic!

There are so many great places to stay in Istanbul, but this one stands out on so many levels. Its located on a small street just off one of the many lively microvillages of the city with just enough third wave coffee, art shops, and cafes, bars, and restaurants to create a sense of place and home, but zero noise. It sits equidistant (i.e. super close) between the Galata Tower, Istikial/Taksim, Cihangir, and Karakoy, blocks from ferries. You go down the stairs from the entrance of the modern building to the apartment, which is itself spread across two levels. Through some magic of architecture, even though you've gone down a floor or two, there are patios to the outside everywhere. The pictures are spot-on...the place features modern design with clean lines, all the appliances you could need (including a modern washer and dryer that work great), ample power outlets, and seating. Behic provides very clear instructions for self-check in, and everything was just awesome.

This place was as described in the listing. Close to the metro(train). Easy to walk to taksim and other areas. The host was very helpful. It was a nice area to stay! The house was clean and the air conditioning worked well. Would stay again.

What a wonderful week in Istanbul!.
Behiç’s listing was exactly as described and looked just like the photo’s.
The location was brilliant. It was a 10 minute walk to the nearest tram station, about a 5 minute walk to Galata Tower, and a 10 minute walk to Istiklal street. It was a brilliant location for sight seeing, shopping and restaurants.
My advice would be to wear comfortable shoes and be prepared to give your calves a great workout, but it’s definitely worth the walking.
Behiç was a fantastic host and was extremely responsive both before and during our stay.
I would happily recommend Behiç’s listing to anyone visiting Istanbul.
It was great.
Thank you Behiç.

description:
It is well equiped, designed by one of the best interior designers of Turkey who is 'Elif ERGİN-Tasarımhane' and everything is new.
Our wi-fi is limitless and has 100 mbps speed.
It is on the 2nd floor of historical building which is builded in 1888.
The flat is 200 meters to Galata Tower, 400 m to Metro, 400 m to İstiklal Street, 850 m to Galataport.
It is placed at the heard of the city. Cosy and boutique cafes, upmarket restaurants are all within walking distance.

reviews.text: We arrived at this Airbnb at 1:00 AM after a long international journey. The location was extremely difficult to access, and our driver had to drop us off at the top of the street because it was too narrow to enter. We then had to walk down with our luggage in the dark. Upon arrival, we encountered multiple very steep and narrow staircases, including two long flights, just to reach the apartment, which was not manageable with luggage. During this process, I tripped and twisted my foot, resulting in swelling and pain. I immediately informed the host, hoping for understanding or assistance, but his response was dismissive and he stated that the injury was due to my “carelessness,” showing no concern. My mother was physically unable to climb the stairs, making it unsafe and impossible for us to stay. Because of this, we did not stay at the property at all and were forced to find a hotel in the middle of the night. Despite the circumstances, the host refused to offer any refund or consider

The apartment is located very close to the Galata Tower and is only a short walk (up a hill) to the Sishane Metro. Clean throughout and felt like a home away from home.
Both Erdem and Burcu were very helpful and quick to respond to messages.
We would stay again when we visit Istanbul.
Harika bir konumda, çok temiz ve huzurlu bir evdi. Galata başta olmak üzere birçok yere yürüyerek ulaşabildik. Ev sahibi çok ilgili ve nazikti. İstanbul’a tekrar gelirsem yine burada kalmak isterim
Lovely hosts and great communication. Fantastic location. Comfy and clean. Highly recommend.

Our stay in the Galata flat was so lovely- the flat is newly renovated and has such a charm! Location is perfect as well as it is in a beautiful part of town and very close to public transport for connections. As a host, Erdem was a superstar and helped make our stay as hassle- free as possible by helping arrange transport from the airport and to the bus station when we were leaving, he gave us wonderful recommendations of local restaurants to visit, gave us some great tips for our stay, and it was overall such a pleasure to be able to meet him and liaise with him on all matters concerning our stay.
Would 10/10 recommend both the apartment and Erdem as a host, if you have the chance to stay here, you will not regret it!
Huge thanks to the awesome host once again! :)

description: I would be pleased to host you in my apartment, which is within walking distance of Uskudar centre, Marmaray, Baglarbasi metro, Nevcarsi and Capitol shopping mall. My apartment is located in the nuh kuyusu street where the bus stop is in front of my building that you can find the buses to everywhere in istanbul. Kadikoy is just taking 5 min from her by bus. There is even dry machine in the apartment for free usage. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to ask.

reviews.text: murad is a very good person with whome you can easy communicate , he helped me with many things i wasnt understand and welcomed me very good . the house was so clean and comfortable the area is calm and good location you can easily go to metro .... i didnt regret it at all actually i will always book this room whenever i come back to istanbul ❤️

the room was spacious clean and quiet, well furnished, the location was perfect, and murat is the greatest host i ever met, too much helpful too much friendly and too much generous, i definitely recommend him

I stayed at Murat's house for a month and it was a very good decision for my trip to Istanbul. Excellent for remote workers (quiet space and stable connection). Since my arrival Murat was always willing to help me during my stay, more than my host he was like a friend, good location, I highly recommend this place.
Highly recommended place to stay in. Very smooth check-in and Murat is very helpful and accommodating. The room is really nice, and you’ll find every you want. Definitely will comeback again.

Murat was the one of the best, if not the best, hosts I have ever had in my Airbnb experience. He is a very helpful person, always available to help you in your need. And you can also have some great conversations with him, he is a very positive person.

description:
The space
Beautifully and modernly designed, comfortable suite in the heart of İstanbul, Beyoğlu. Feel the mystic wind with the combination of traditional and modern structures of this amazing city in a well designed room which is very close to the never-sleeping street İstiklal!

Guest access
There is a kitchen, bathroom in our room. In addition, there is a TV, free wi-fi, air-conditioner, towel and shampoo the room. You can enjoy cooking in your room if you want, and have a rest after a fresh shower.

Registration Details

reviews.text: We had a really great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and welcoming, and everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out. The only small downside was that the Wi-Fi was a bit slow at times, but overall it didn’t take away from a very positive experience. We’d happily stay here again and would recommend it to others.

Thank you for your welcome and hospitality! Clean small mini hotel, with comfortable rooms, air conditioning, microwave, refrigerator, that's all I needed is in the room. The kind host of Evrim will tell you and help you with various questions. The location is convenient, close to the famous Istiklal street and Taksim square, many places where you can eat.

This was not a traditional airbnb as it was a professional suite business. It was refreshing and extremely well located. The room was clean and the bedding and shower etc. were top standard at a great price!
This is a little gross and dirty hotel. Your room most likely will not be the one in the photos. Location is the only thing good here but not worth it.

Unfortunately, for me this was the worst place I ve ever stayed. The room looks really good in photos, but in reality, the furniture and everything in the bathroom is old and functions poorly. There was a horrible smell in the entire building during our whole stay, you can hear everything from the outside and the towels were dirty. Although the towels were exchanged daily, they had a weird smell and stains.
The only good thing about this stay was the communication with the host - they were always at the desk and helped us with the PCRs tests + the fact that we were close to one Main Street from Taksim.
Overall tho, I would not recommend this place if you are sensitive to different smells and like clean stuff.

description:
Welcome to Grisverde Suites in vibrant Ataşehir, Istanbul.
Our modern suites are ideal for business travelers, medical visitors, and tourists.

Enjoy a separate living and bedroom, a comfortable sofa bed, and a luxurious bathroom with a walk-in shower and hairdryer.

The stylish workspace and fast Wi-Fi keep you connected. Experience the comfort of home with hotel luxury. Book your stay at Grisverde Suites today!

reviews.text:
Konakladığım en temiz aribnb eviydi.
Otopark sorunu yoktu
Konumu merkezi ve giriş oldukça kolaydı
3 kişi konaklamamıza rağmen mutfakta sadece 2 kasık, 2 catal cok az sayıda tabak ve bardak vardı. Bardakları ikinci gün temizlemek için bulaşık deterjanı yoktu
Ancak ev sahibi hızlıca temin etti

Evdeki televizyonda hiç bir kanal çıkmıyordu

The location is excellent and all services are within walking distance. The hotel staff welcomes you kindly, cozy suite is very comfortable and clean. I recommend staying there.👍

We booked 8 nights and were honestly very happy with our stay. The building was clean, everything was exactly as described, and we felt right at home as soon as we arrived.
The check-in and check-out process went very smoothly as well. We would definitely stay here again if we return to Istanbul.

Tüm sorularımız anlayışlı ve sabırlı şekilde hızlıca yanıtlandı, ev girdiğimiz andan itibaren temiz ve güzel kokuyordu. Konum, bilgilendirme ve fotoğraf ile uyum arasında hiçbir fark yoktu. Apartmana ait otopark da çok işimize yaradı. Profesyonelliğiniz için teşekkür ederiz, içimize sinen bir konaklama oldu.

The apartment was very clean, comfortable and with a comfortable bed. It’s about 17 bus stops from the city centre, but the bus stops right on the same street, which makes getting around very convenient. Communication was excellent — anytime I had a question, the team was quick to respond and very helpful. Overall, I would definitely recommend staying at Gris Verde.

One A/C in the living room and One Fan in the bedroom.

description: Welcome to our distinctive detached home in the heart of the historic Cukurcuma area. Close to all tourist attractions and yet a hidden gem in a small alley. The former Greek church has been converted into a modern 2 bedroom house.

reviews.text: Nice place but, be careful the stairs leading up to the upper bedroom has a flooring layer which is approximately 2 3/4 inches high. This made the top step almost three inches taller than the others. I sometimes lost my balance usually upon waking heading down the stairs but I never fell. The shower on the second floor had a steel grate that would not sit flush and the corners were sharp. This shower also had a door improperly installed and allowed water to spill into the bedroom floor unless a towel was used to block the water which was now staining and rotting the nice wood floors. We had two beds; one bed only had a fitted sheet and the other only had a top sheet. The mattress had no protector and was stained. Host provided 1 bath towel each for a 5 night stay and requested I pay to replace the dirty towels , this was without even attempting to launder the towels. I refused and requested that the towels be laundered as I was certain a wash would clean them.

This was an amazing find and in a perfect location, out of the way of the busier streets but very close and walkable to so many places being so centrally located.
The space is a great mix of the original features of the building but modernised facilities and design. It was very comfortable and unlike many Airbnbs, they did not go cheap on the bed/mattress which was high quality. Temperature wise it was always comfortable and has excellent heating and cooling.
There is a construction project underway just outside of the property as of the time of this stay but they never started too early or went too late so was not really an issue for us… impact was minimal and would not discouraged me from staying here again.
Hosts were fantastic, gave very clear instructions and were always very quick to respond with any questions etc. and gave some good local recommendations.
So much about this stay was excellent and would highly recommended!

We LOVED this house! The place is absolutely amazing and looked exactly as in the pictures. The interior and design is perfectly done. Also, a well located place, super comfortable, quite, private, clean, safe and the host is super helpful. It truly felt like home and I would absolutely stay here again!!

“This was my second time staying here, and it was just as great as the first. The space was clean, well-stocked, and exactly as described. Check-in was seamless, and the host was responsive and easy to communicate with. The location worked perfectly for our trip. Would absolutely stay again — highly recommend!”

What an incredible rental property! So perfectly located, comfortable, and very cool in decor and design. Unlike any place I’ve ever stayed! Comfortable bed, wonderful shower, and the host were responsive and helpful. Great communication and support. Could not recommend more highly. Thanks for a great place to stay in Instabul!

description: Enjoy a stylish experience in this centrally located place. Both rooms suitable for families have double beds. The sofa in the living room is a very comfortable sleeping area.

reviews.text:
To list the obvious:
- the apartment is a top floor without an elevator (and that’s fine considering you have no trouble walking. If you have, it would be wise to reconsider)
- the neighborhood is good
- the apartment is clean and the shower was repaired (there is no mold as per older reviews)
- the apartment is quite old and therefore be ready for a certain discomfort, because electrical sockets are few and in bizarre places.
Overall, quite good for the price paid. Again, be careful, the neighborhood is located up a very steep hill, which gives more points to the view, but — oh, boy — it is sometimes really difficult to go up the hill :)

The place was absolutely wonderful. I would recommend it!
The living room was spacious, perfect for a little dance, and the large corner sofa was excellent for relaxing after a packed day exploring the city.
The kitchen is well equipped but not large, it is nice there is a dishwasher but it is not easy to use in the cramped space.
The bathroom is clean and easy use. Very handy there is a washing/drying machine, especially if you have a longer stay.
There is a nice view from the window, but more so just around the corner as soon as you step out of the door. There is lovely dining place merrily a few steps away that is luxurious with a view over the Bosphorus, excellent food and yet very affordable pricing. Actually the best value restaurant we found in Istanbul and it is just around the corner.
The apartment is on the top floor, as advertised, which I enjoyed as it makes the place more quiet, peaceful and with a better view. Keep in mind you do have to walk 5 stories up the stairs.

The pictures for bathroom and kitchen need updating as this are not accurate any more. The shower door was broken, the host mentioned this at checkin - this should have been fixed as she was aware of reservation 2 months ago, from the damage it was obvious this was not a recent issue as claimed and this wasn't fixed during our stay as mentioned. Mould in the shower, broken toilet seat and the flush doesn't always fill up with water, needs fiddling with tank lever.
The host needs to be aware, visitors do not always have wifi so last minute changes to prior arrangement is not helpful and not to schedule delivery of appliances during reservation.
Early checkin was allowed but poorly executed, so I appreciate the effort.
The keys were not found as instructed, you need keys to get in through the main door whereas the instruction read this were in a black box (there is no such box) outside the apartment.
Pictures should include the graffiti wall outside to help with location of building

Cool and stylish apartment, just as described. It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The apartment is on the top floor without an elevator, but the views are worth it. Fatoş was quick to respond to our questions and very friendly throughout. Would stay here again and recommend it to others.

Nice spatious flat in the heart of Istanbul. You’ll have most of the main places of the city near it. Sultanahmet, Galata tower, the spices market are all accessible with the T1 just a few minutes from the appartment. And in the other direction you’re just 10 min of walk away from Taksim square.
The appartment was clean and the host was available at any moment to help us.
Just an information that some might need to take into consideration, the flat is at the 5th and last floor without elevator. So if you are not afraid of stairs,
I would totally recommand.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Disappointing stay at this airbnb. First, the listing said that the unit had free parking on the premises AND free street parking. There is no parking on premises and street parking is completely impossible to find, even at midnight. We ended up paying for Autopark and drag suitcases 500 meters in a very crowded neighborhood. The apartment was not clean at all even though they charge a hefty "cleaning fee". Dust, debris and dead bugs everywhere. The washing machine was so dirty and moldy. The fridge and AC units were greasy and grimy too. The unit reeked of cigarette smoke, especially in the bedroom where it made it hard to sleep. They rented to 4 people but only had 1 twin bed and expected the other 2 guests to sleep on the "convertable" couches. They didn't provide any sheets or towels for the other 2 guests. The high price they charged for this very small unit, combined with some nice photos led us to believe it would be a great stay but we were wrong.

the apartment was very clean ...it's near all public transportations and close to all places....the host and stuff are so friendly and helpful ...all furniture and mattress almost new and good quality....

The place is in a communicative area. You can reach all historical objects and popular destinations by foot or public transport. There are transport options like: subway, trams, buses and all of them are 5-9 mins walk. The apartment is on the first floor. It is easy to find the location. It was clean, tidy and cozy. There are groceries, restaurants, small places to have traditional breakfast, near it.
Olcay is a great host. Always online for any questions and helpful person. The communication was easy, in a good level. He was open to give us any information we needed.
I recommend his place.

The house needs a lot of attention to cleanliness and furnishings. The bed linens and pillows were very dirty old and stained. The bathroom sink has no hot water. As for the living room, it's right next to the street and has absolutely no soundproofing.

Ailecek rahat bir şekilde kalabileceğimiz her türlü ihtiyacınızın düşünüldüğü ve iletişimin kolay olduğu bir yer. Olcay Bey gayet profesyonel bir şekilde iletişime geçti. Özellikle bölgenin en temiz en güvenilir yerlerinden bir tanesi

description:
A two-bedroom apartment in Teşvikiye, on a quiet street, a two-minute walk from the American Hospital.

The windows of the bedrooms face the trees and the park. The front of the living room is open: beyond the rooftops, the Bosphorus can be seen in the distance. There are blackout curtains — you wake up when you want to wake up, not with the morning sun.

I offer a discounted monthly price for those who will stay longer than a month.

reviews.text: I had a pleasant stay. The place was clean, quiet, and exactly as described. The host was polite, very responsive, and easy to communicate with, making everything smooth and stress-free. Overall, a very comfortable stay with family, very good value, and I would like to highly recommended this place.

I did stay with my family in Can’s place for almost 2 weeks. We had an amazing experience at the apartment, everything was perfect and same as it’s shown in the pictures. Clean apartment , very nice neighbourhood, small supermarket is practically downstairs and there are many shops, cafés and restaurants nearby. The host was very helpful and responsive. Highly recommend and I would definitely book it again in my next visits.

Can is a great host! He was so responsive with any questions during our stay, and he also was flexible with my parents’ early check in which I was so grateful for that!!
There are so many shopping centers, restaurants, and markets with walking distance to this place but the walk is so hilly and even though I was fine with walking around, it was not very convenient for my parents to walk in the neighborhood! So I would recommend this place if you’re traveling with a younger group of people!
This place has two bedrooms with two beds (a queen size bed in one of the rooms and a twin bed in the second room), so to me it’s perfect for 3 guests!
If you are planning to not to cook a lot in your stay, like what we did, you will be fine with the kitchen equipments! But there is not enough kitchen supplies for cooking for those who enjoy cooking their own meals!
In general we really enjoyed our time at Can’s place and I would definitely recommend this place!

The house was so clean location is great close to very famous shops , cafes and restaurants in walking distance. But the flat is very cosy and comfortable and quiet . It has a great view of Bosporus. We had a fantastic time. The host Can is very kind very friendly and responsive. Many thanks to him for being such a great host .

Can is an excellent host with outstanding communication — always responsive, friendly, and helpful. The apartment is in a very convenient and well-connected location, making it easy to get around and explore the city.
The place itself has everything you need for a comfortable and pleasant stay: it’s clean, well-organized, and thoughtfully equipped. We felt right at home from the moment we arrived.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend both the apartment and Can as a host. We would be more than happy to stay here again in the future.

description:
It is in a central location, 5-10 minutes away from locations such as Taksim, Beşiktaş, Karaköy, Ortaköy and Sisli by car/taxi
It is within walking distance to the "Bomonti-Tünel" and "Feriköy" bus stops. It takes 20min walking to Osmanbey metro station

It is also close to Memorial Hospital

Spacious 80mt2, 2 bedrooms and 1 living room house

reviews.text:
We're very happy that we chose Eren's house as an Airbnb. It is very spacious and spotlessly cleaned. It has all the amenities we needed during our stay: Well equipped kitchen, functioning heater, dishwasher, washing machine with the soap..
The building where this apartment is located is also new and it has an elevator, and the neighborhood is calm and safe. Few minutes away from the house you can get groceries and vegetables. There is even a small park for kids just near the house.
I think my favorite thing about the apartment was the living room as the couches were very comfortable to chill and hangout in. Also the view from the second room was amazing !
Eren was very accommodating to all of our needs, he made sure that the stay is very comfortable for us. Him and his wife speak very good English, and communication wasn't an issue. Also they gave us a very thorough list of recommendations on where to go, and which transportation to use.
Overall I would definitely recommend this house, it would easily fit an entire family without feeling tight on space, it is also very cozy, and it feels just like home. I would give 10 it stars if I can !!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment and would happily return. The place was as pictured, clean and well maintained. It had everything we needed for a comfortable longer stay, including a reliable internet connection and a well-equipped kitchen.
The location was good for us and quiet and relaxing.
The host was responsive, friendly, and provided clear instructions for check-in and throughout our stay. They also fixed any issues promptly. Recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay.

Eren was very very responsive and always helpful. We really enjoyed our stay and felt like home away from home. Kitchen is really spacious and fully equipped. Lounge is so comfortable to sit and enjoy our evening after a busy day. Nice large enough bedrooms. Bathroom with lovely large sink and mirror and clean shower area. Good WiFi and I used it some days to work remotely. The whole apartment is so spotless. We loved walking to Osmanbey metro but there is a bus can take you to Osmanbey taksim and Eminönü.

I recently stayed at Eren's place and had a wonderful experience! The place was incredibly clean and well-maintained, which made my stay all the more comfortable. The host was also incredibly supportive and made sure that everything was taken care of during my stay. It was easy to communicate with him and he was always responsive and helpful.
One of the things I loved about the location was the proximity to many stores and amenities. It made it easy to pick up any necessities I needed during my stay, and I didn't have to travel far to get anything I needed.
Overall, I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay. The cleanliness and the host's support were outstanding, and I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again in the future. Thanks for a great stay!

I cannot recommend it highly enough. I spent 2 weeks here with my friends and we thoroughly enjoyed it . The house has everything you need and everything was sparkling clean. Living room has a comfy sofa and a large TV. WiFi is fast and stable for remote work. Shower has great pressure. Kitchen has all cooking utensils you need.
The flat is in a great location, It’s very easy to move around , There are supermarkets and restaurants nearby.
On top of all that, the host is always available to help on anything you might help either regarding the flat or visiting Istanbul, even offering support on random things like clothes shopping etc.
I cannot wait to return to Istanbul and stay here again.

description: The whole group will be comfortable in this spacious and unique place. Shopping mall under the most prestigious residence in Ataşehir

reviews.text: Fantastic stay! Clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was super responsive, and the location was perfect. Highly recommend!

One of the best host! Very very quick response all the times, very efficient and pleasant communication. The house is very nice! Exactly like the photoes and with a fantastic view in every room. All the supplies are super, even beverages and bottled water in the refrigerator. The transportation is bery convenient! And a good amount of fine restaurants and bars around. A super market right under the building. Hope to come back again and recommend to everyone.

We chose this house mainly because of its convenient location close to our family members in the area, which worked well for us. However, overall, our stay was unfortunately not as comfortable as we had hoped.
The cleanliness of the house did not meet our expectations, and most of the cooking pans were heavily worn and unusable, so we had to purchase a few ourselves in order to cook during our stay. The towels also appeared very old and overly used, which made them uncomfortable to use.
Another major issue for us was the brightness in the bedrooms. Very early in the morning (around 5:40–6:00 a.m.), the rooms became extremely bright, making it difficult for us — especially our toddler — to sleep properly. We tried covering the windows to reduce the light, but unfortunately it only helped slightly.
We appreciate the location and convenience of the property, but we hope these issues can be improved for future guests.

First of all, Can's responsiveness and hospitality is priceless. He is extremely genuine, thrust worthy and very accommodating to make the stay at high standards. Place is very nicely furnished with many amenities. It is clean, quiet and modern high-rise with great city view. Highly satisfied and strongly recommend
Good location. The house was clean and has nice view. Lots of good restaurants nearby. Parking space was available right under the building. Can arranged whatever we needed before we checked in.

description:
Welcome to our building located in Hürriyet neighborhood, situated next to Florence Hospital and in close proximity to Çağlayan Metro Station. This prime location offers easy access to the entire city, making it a convenient choice for residents.

The building features fully furnished apartments, specifically designed with comfort and style in mind

reviews.text: Despite our mutual agreement on check-in time, we arrived to check-in, had to wait for building management to call host and wait for the host and cleaner to arrive, placed in another apartment while ours was cleaned. Also, host answered three phone calls (we requested extension plugs three times, was told he would provide three times, but it never came). From first night, there was smoke smell within the apartment. It took us several nights to isolate it -- it was coming through the bathroom vent. Since hosts had not responded to extension plug request three times, he would clearly not respond to this. This was a highly disappointing stay. The smoke smell permeated the entire apartment even though we were in the front living room, despite closed doors would travel into all the rooms. We were sick during most of our stay, and the smoke made it much worse. Sad to say this ruined our trip. Do not recommend the unresponsive host. I've stayed at Airbnb for years. This is most disappointing.

Lokasyon olarak çok merkezi bir yerde.Toplu taşıma kullanarak ve yürüyerek her yere ulaşma imkanı sağlıyor.Fotoğraflarda gördüğüm daire ile birebir aynı.Hijyen ve genel temizlikten tam puan veriyorum.Misafirlerinin konforunu ve ihtiyaçlarını düşünen bir yerde konaklamaktan memnun kaldım.Uzun konaklamalar içinde tercih edeceğim :)

Je le recommande !

Thank you for a good stay. We got help when we needed, Amir answered all our questions asap, was flexible and helpful. We had everything we needed in the apartment and a good view as well. It took us 2 min to get to stores and shopping mall was also near by. We took taxi to Fatih which took us only 15 min.
Konum, temizlik, Barış beyin ilgi alakası herşey yok iyiydi. Güzel bir deneyim oldu. Herkese tabsiye ederim.

description: Our apartments are distinguished by the spacious area suitable for family residence, as it contains all the necessary necessities for a comfortable and happy stay, where you feel as if you are in your own home. We also have a 24/24 reception desk to secure the needs of guests at any time, and the entire building contains a security system and cameras that work around the clock In addition to the availability of the Internet throughout the hotel, also the apartments have amazing city view

reviews.text:
This place was amazing; it's comfortable, exactly as shown in the photos, and spacious enough for six people. The receptionist really work for 24 hours and was quite responsive, when there was an issue with the bathroom door. We complained at night, and by the next day, it was fixed. When we needed things like toilet paper or new towels, they quickly provided them. Our belongings were also delivered to the room. The elevator worked very well.
The location is also convenient, close to a bus stop, though it’s a bit of a walk to the Osmanbey metro station. The area is walkable, and there are plenty of shopping spots nearby, such as clothing stores, restaurants, and grocery stores.
The only downside is the kitchen, as it’s not fully equipped with items like a spatula, a knife and chopping board, so we had to either buy or bring these items ourselves for cooking needs.
And it could’ve been better if they provide a microwave especially in winter time
but overall hexa was a good place to

The apartment was exactly as the picture. Ryad at the front desk was helpful and very friendly! We will stay there again for sure. The place was big, we were 4 adults and 2 children and there was a lot of space with 1 full bathroom and 1 half bathroom. The only thing to note is that it’s more of a hotel with a kitchen. This means there is salt and pepper and paper towel in the kitchen. Everything else you have to buy. Forks and plates, and cups available but Kitchen soap and kitchen sponge not provided to wash them. There is pots and pans but no oil. There was a stove top but no lighter to light the gaz. There is a dishwasher but no dishwasher soap. Same there is a washing machine but no soap to wash the clothes. It’s nothing big just plan accordingly as a real airbnb has all the basic stuff provided usually, like if u were home. For the price paid it was perfect, and reasonable . we didn’t mind getting what we needed from the supermarket just 2 minutes away.

İstanbul gezimizde konakladığımız bu evden genel olarak çok memnun kaldık. Ev sahibi tüm sorularımıza hızlıca cevap verdi; eve geç giriş yapacağımızı ilettiğimizde 24 saat resepsiyon olduğunu söylediler ve gerçekten de 22:00’de sorunsuz bir şekilde giriş yaptık. Ev temizdi ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Konaklama sırasında kombi çalışmadığında hemen ilgilenip çözdüler. İstanbul’da otopark sıkıntılı olabiliyor ama biz kapının önüne rahatça park ettik, sorun yaşamadık. Genel olarak hem evden hem de ev sahibinin ilgisinden çok memnun kaldık, gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz.

I stayed for a couple of days. Everything was as described—the location is good, and the amenities were also good. The apartment itself was a bit old and not very well maintained, but it was clean. What really stood out was the reception staff—they were very friendly and helpful throughout my stay.

Overall a good place to stay. Location is central, not too busy, close to public transportation.
The staff were nice and friendly. They were flexible with early check in.
Some concerns:
1- though this is a non smoking property, but you sense the smoke all the time.
2- we found a burning smoke hole in the bed sheet.
3- there are multiple black mold around the bathroom.
4- the kitchen stove was broken.

description:
3 bedroom apt. is 130m2 , it has 3 Bedrooms, 3 Bathrooms,2 Fully Kitchen, 3 AC, 3 TV , 4 sofa bed(can turn a bed), 1 living place.
Building has lift and 24 hours reception service.
Who always care about your requests.
Location of the flat is at the central of old part of İstanbul, you can reach almost all turistic places in just 4 minutes.
Such as Galata Port,Galata Tower, istiklal Street,Ferry station, Metro station, Tram station, and iconic caffes, bars, Pub.11 guest stay here comfortably.

reviews.text:
Had a great stay here—everything was exactly as described (if not better). The place was very clean, well-maintained, and had all the essentials plus a few nice extra touches that made it feel comfortable and easy to settle in.
The host was responsive, friendly, and made check-in and check-out super smooth. Communication was quick and clear the whole time, which made the experience stress-free.
The location was also a big plus—convenient, safe, and close to everything I needed.
Overall, I’d definitely stay here again and would recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and comfortable spot.
Also left my ring behind ! Looking to get it shipped , doing me a huge favor ! I appreciate that !

This apartment was amazing!! I can’t say enough great things about this apartment. It was soooo clean and nice. The 3 bedrooms fit our whole family of 6 people so comfortably. The sheets and pillar were so clean and comfortable. The shower was great. Also the apartment was located in a great location. So many great shops and stores right outside the apartment. We were 10 min from our cruise and all the shopping district. All the store owners were also so nice. And most importantly, our host was wonderful. We felt so safe staying at this apartment since this was our first time in Istanbul and we didn’t speak the language. Our host was always there to assist. It was like having family in Istanbul to watch over us. I highly recommend this place to anyone staying in Istanbul.

We had a great stay! The apartment is in a fantastic location just a few minutes’ walk to Galataport and very close to Taksim, Istiklal Street, public transport, shops, cafes, and even a pharmacy right at the doorstep. The reception staff was absolutely lovely, warm, and welcoming, which made us feel right at home. The apartment is very spacious, and even with 8 of us, we never felt cramped. The furniture is well looked after and comfortable.
The host was very responsive and quick to solve any queries we had, which we really appreciated.
That said, the bathrooms could use some renovation, as the drainage had a smell and the showers often got blocked. The walls would benefit from a fresh coat of paint, and the terrace/balcony could use a touch-up, especially the outdoor furniture.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and with a few updates, this apartment would be perfect.

Ulvi is a great host, i do feel welcome as he also make an effort asking for my eta ahead of time. His apartment is very strategic and at very good location, walkable to the gelata tower in less than 3 min and walkable to the tram station in2-3 min as well. Our ride can drop off us in front of the apartment is another plus for staying at ulvi’s place. I came with 11 paxs ( 1 elderly) and booked 3 bedrooms which all at same level and yet we still have our own privacy. Ulvi’s place equipped with a lift easy for us to transport our luggage up and good for elder rather than using stairs. Pharmacy, grocery store and restaurant just few step away. It has everything and still so peaceful. I’m sure will stay here again if visting istanbul.

I stayed in this apartment with my family with 10 adults.
There is inside 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 2 kitchens and 1 living area.
Everything was convenient and great, we also liked the location very much. It was only a few minutes' walk from the seaside,Galataport mall, tram, metro, galata tower, Mr. Ulvi hosted us very well. he was very kind and helpful, we will definitely come again thank you

description: You can stay with your family or friends with peace of mind in this apartment located in a central location in Beşiktaş Square. You should definitely see this apartment, which is close to everywhere in Beşiktaş and within walking distance.

reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay. The place is big with a lot of space and it is located in a great location and you were very responsive. The kitchen was well stocked. But the house needs some fixing and more cleaning (my wife washed the shower and bathroom). Also need to provide more towels (there is only one large towel for three people)

Many thanks to Sinan for his hospitality .
Evin konumu çok merkezi ve ev sahibi her konuda çok yardımcı oldu. Ev yeterince temiz ve ferahtı. Tavsiye ederim.

Overall this is a good airbnb. The location is amazing and close to bus station and besiktas Iskele (which you can use Istanbul card and go everywhere). There are a lot of shops and bars close to the place. The building is a little old which I think it’s normal in besiktas. Some of the furniture needs maintainable or replacement. But overall it’s a good value for money

description:
You will be able to enjoy the silhouette of Büyükada with your family or friends in this spacious and unique place located on the upper floor of Büyükada Çınar Hotel 2. You will start the day with the street on the balcony. Our hotel is in the center of the bazaar, within walking distance to the pier. There are restaurants, markets, cafes and bus stops nearby.

*Each individual must provide identification at the entrance to the facility. Guests under the age of 19 are not accepted.

I believe the place is perfect for that price in that time of the year, the location is excellent, the room is quite enough to spend a night for one person or a couple. I didn’t like the cigarettes smell however - I had a feeling it’s almost embedded in that apartment, I hope other rooms are ok.

Her sey mükemmeldi denilebilir, uzun zamandır konakladığım en temiz yerdi. Konum meydana yakın, nevresim ve havlular yumuşatıcı kokulu, banyo tuvalet hijyeni sanki evinizdeki gibi tertemizdi.
