Otelin konumu guzeldi ve genel olarak guzel bir oteldi. Calisanlar ilgili ve yardimciydi. Ancak hic ses yalıtımı yok otelde. Bu biraz rahatsiz ediciydi. Baska odada hapsurulsa bu bile duyuluyordu. Bunun disinda her sey guzeldi. Adaya gelirseniz fiyat performans olarak iyi bi secenek..

description: Brand new, with 3.20m high ceilings, original wall ornaments and balcony. Located in the Beyoglu - Cukurcuma district, this apartment is just a 2-minute walk from Istiklal Street, the heart and soul of cultural life in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
We had an incredible experience at this Airbnb. The place is absolutely stunning—spacious, clean, and beautifully designed. The amenities were complete, with everything we needed for a comfortable stay, from kitchen essentials to cozy linens. The host was incredibly attentive, always available to answer any questions, and the communication was seamless throughout.
The location couldn't be better—just a short walk to Taksim and Tophane tram stations, making it easy to explore Istanbul. We will definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the city!

We had a lovely stay at the apartment. the area is great and the location on the antique-shop street is very charming. Also well connected. The apartment itself has everyone one might need, it is nicely furnished and have a very nice old Istanbul feel. The air conditioning is only in the living room but reaches the rest of the apartment too. There is a fan in the bedroom. The apartment is next to a school so you might hear some music/movie from there with open windows. the stairs to get in are steep and could be challenging with heavy suitcases. Overall I would definitely recommend the apartment. Communication was also very good. Thank you!

We had a nice time at Wassim's place. Apartment is 10-15 minutes walking distance to tram (Tophane) & bus stop although it can be bit hilly. The apartment was nice & contained all the amenities one may require for a comfortable stay.
Unfortunately the listing did not mention about the fact you will have to climb three flights of stairs to get to the apartment. If you have elderly family members or lot of luggages, this might be difficult. We found the bed to be on the soft side but comfortable. It appeared to be a queen size bed rather than king size as mentioned in the listing.
Lot of restaurants can be found if you walk 10-15 minutes from apartment. We found the local places on the way to the tram stop to be lot cheaper and tastier than the restaurants in tourist areas.
It is best to avoid taxis in Istanbul as they are not always tourist friendly. We booked private airport transfer both ways through Klook website (luxurious large Mercedes van) and it was around 30 euro each way.

Great area and lovely place. Perfect for 2 people, maybe a couple and one other. The ac is only in the living room but it does cool the bedroom down decently if you leave the drapes closed during the day. Host was very responsive when we needed a fan and a drying rack. Some water was made available as well which was very nice. Heavy front door but very secure, and a few flights of steps to get up to the apartment but not bad. Pretty quiet in the evening given it’s proximity to Istiklal street. Small markets and cafes very close by. Metro is 8 min walk. Great place, cool vibe!

The flat was absolutely beautiful — clean, stylish, and comfortable. The neighbourhood was lovely and felt very safe, with plenty of nice spots nearby. Communication with the host was flawless; they were responsive and helpful throughout our stay. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!

description:
Enjoy a stylish vacation experience in this centrally located house in Istanbul, the most beautiful city in the world.
Our house has a work area and desk, internet, 2 air conditioners, washing, dishwashing and drying machines, refrigerator, stove, aspirator, microwave and normal ovens, Turkish and filter coffee machines, hair dryer and toasters, iron and ironing board, clothes hanger and vacuum cleaner. Our house is on the 3rd floor of a family apartment building, it has flat, wide, comfortable stairs, but no elevator!!!

reviews.text:
as an architect, i absolutely loved the interior design of the space. that’s the first thing that caught my eye! it was exactly like the pictures!
secondly, the level of detail of everything thats provided is so insanely well thought out! from sandwich makers to beautiful trays to detergent to house slippers to a huge ironing board for ppl over 6ft! i was in love every day discovering the thoughtfulness of Semra.
every piece of furniture is so comfortable and clean and pretty, it really was home outside of home. the sofas are soft and massive! as a 6ft person, i loved laying on it :)
and Semra and her sister Suna are the loveliest people you will ever meet. They are so kind and at your service at any time, what beautiful people. Her sister lives in the building so check in and check out were so smooth. i’ll recommend this place to anyone i know looking for a place to stay in turkey for any amount of days.
theres a bakery, clothing stores and a mall at walking distance.
12/10

Perfect, new and clean apartment, fully equipped. lots of great amenities and a great location that’s close to local malls, bus station and metro. Everything was exactly like described and is very suitable for a family of 6.
Semra, The host was very responsive and was very flexible on time to check out , her sister and nephew was so helpful and kind.
Thanks a lot semra for the apartment you truly made our vacation.

Semra's place was super clean and is worth five stars. the furniture is clean, new and high quality. The location is fantastic with all you need downstairs. The metro station is 10 minutes walk. Semra and her family were very kind and helpful. They responded to communication very fast and very kindly.
I highly recommend this place.

The place is large and can accommodate up to 6 people. It is centrally located and 10 minutes away from a metro station. The place was clean overall but there were some blood stains on some of the sheets. The bathroom has no ventilation and the smell builds up after a few days. The unit is on the 3rd floor and has a lot of stairs making it uncomfortable specially for the older people.

My family loved our stay at Semra’s. It felt like home. It was super clean and blankets smell great. The two couches were extendable as big a a single bed or even bigger, you can comfortably sleep on them whole night. Semra”s sister Suna is staying in the same building and helped us with check in & check out process. Since the building doesn’t have elevator, Suna was kind enough to ask her husband to carry out luggages up to third floor. We had such hard time booking a can to move our stuff when we checked out, but Suna spend almost an hour finding us a van online. She called so many taxi services and made sure we get to our next destination comfortably. Highly recommend this place.
Only thing to be aware of is the building doesn’t have elevator.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. The site is secure and has a pool. There is a gym and restaurants at the entrance of the site.

reviews.text:
Totally disappointed of this hospitality.
The apartment was not cleaned well, there were some leftovers in the refrigerator. There were no bed sheets and the sofa was not prepared to welcome third guest. The mattress and the sofa were stained. No internet connection, while there was router and the host told that there is infrastructure problem in the building, which was totally not true, other apts have internet connection.
During all of the time, the host was unresponsive on his phone/**** (chat application). Rarely, he replied with one word on AirBnb.
When we faced these problems, some guy from the security came. He doesn’t speak English and he was totally unaware of how to react.

Great place with walking distance to both metro stations (to city and to IST Airport). Clean apartment with access to pool and 24/7 security. The apartment has air conditioning in both bedroom and living room and a nice view from the balcony.
On the ground floor there is a grocery store and several other shops and restaurants. All in all, a great deal for a pleasant stay in Istanbul!
OBS: There was no Wi-Fi access at the time of our stay, but this was reflected in the listing - just be aware and read it carefully before booking.

The house is located in a very good area. It is small but enough for two-three people.
There is no internet in the house which is a problem for who don't have the internet access from theire carrier. Anıl is responsive all the time you want to ask for anything. Overall it is suggested for stay in İSTANBUL.

8/10 location
4/10 cleaners
8/10 communication
6/10 facilities
Ev çok temiz ve konforluydu, manzarası da çok tatlı.Otoparkı da mevcut .Anıl beye herhangi bir durumda hemen ulaşabildim.Rahatlıkla konaklayabilirsiniz.

description:
Central building at the heart of city in a historical neighbourhood.
G&L ok ;)
You can reach to most popular pedestrian street (Istiklal Street) in few minutes on foot.
75 sqm 2 bedroom apartment on 6th floor and there is no lift at building.

reviews.text:
We originally stayed at Yaprak's other apartment, but changed our plans, and extended our stay in Istanbul. After having checked other listings in Istanbul, and given our time in Yaprak's first listing, we decided to take up her offer on the new place she had just opened up around the corner from the original, and we are very happy we did. Tons of style, very cozy and comfortable. There were two large queen sized beds which fit the three of us. We really liked Yaprak's styling, and this one was amazing.

The apartment had two bedrooms. One had a small closet and storage space, while the other had a rack to hang clothes on. Each bed was clean and comfortable. The kitchen had two gas burners, a coffee maker, and a refrigerator. It's not exactly setup to cook meals in, but worked out for breakfast and snacks. A small couch and chair and coffee table rounded out the furnishing, as well as a TV with satellite TV. There is also a balcony with a very nice view, but it didn't get much use as it was snowing much of the time. Washer was also in the apartment, but no drier, although there was a drying rack available for use. A gas boiler provided hot water and heat, and more than enough of it. Internet is also available.

Yaprak was helpful and responded quickly to communication via Wechat. She was out of the country, so her friend actually let us in, although she didn't speak any English.

The building itself is on a small street a few blocks off of Istiklal Avenue, which is a long tourist-oriented shopping and entertainment street. Lots of restaurants and late night options, as well as bars. The street itself is very hilly, and you'll need to climb 5 flights of stairs to get to the apartment, so be cognizant of that. The buildings are old, and not well lit, so it might not be the best for some people, but the apartment was great. There are also some small shops and a mini Carrefour around the corner. Location is convenient, about a ten minute walk to the Taksim Tram / Metro station; there is also a bus that will take you to Eminonu in about ten minutes. Uber also had no problem finding the building.

Couple good spots nearby:

Durumzade: Bourdain stopped here, totally worth it for skewers. Had the chicken wings, lentil soup, beef liver. Hole in the wall, closes around 6pm.

Yeni Lokanta (http://www.lokantayeni.com/) : High end Turkish off of Istiklal.

Lipsos: didn't eat here, but was recommended for mezze by a local. In the heart of a very aggressive row of restaurants.

Sampiyon Kokorec: also didn't eat here, but local suggested it for intestine on a spit.

Alaryan: random spot we popped into. GREAT middle eastern food, but crowded and loud.

All in all, an excellent experience, and when I return to Istanbul, I know who I will be staying with.

Very close to the city center, however the area is very dirty with a lot of trash on a streets . Flat is on the six floor without elevator, spiral stairs.
The roof has a leak , it is very uncomfortable to have a wet floor. Kitchen area is very cold. Plugs are forced out.
In general the price doesn’t meet the quality. The host is nice and prompt at answering.
Merhabalar, İstiklal caddesine yakın ama apartman etrafi çok kötü durumda, kirli, çöplü bir yer, eski binalar ve sakıncalı bi bölge öldüğünü düşünüyorüm. Aparmanda asansör bulunmamaktadir dolasiyla 6 cı kata yürüyerek çlkılması lazim. Evin fiyati evin durumuna hic için uygun değildir. Mütfak çatısından su damliyor, mütfakta oturulmuyor çok söguk bi oda, ev sahibleri durumla ile ilgili biliyorlar ama hiç bişey yapmadilar.

The apartment is nicely appointed with everything you would need. It has a nice space, is tastefully decorated and has a great verandah overlooking the neighborhood. However although it is 10 minutes walk from Istiklal street - a lovely pedestrian ramble with many shops - the area in between is extremely run-down and dirty. We did not feel safe although we were assured it wasn’t dangerous. Also be aware the lobby and 6 stairwells were also filthy, poorly lit and full of rubbish. This doesn’t make for a good impression and arriving late at night is a really bad idea.
We had numerous issues with safely, hot water, etc and had it not been for an extremely kind and helpful agent, who really tried to make our stay less stressful we would have checked into a hotel.
If you are looking for an inexpensive apartment - with a great verandah, not far from the main tourist areas and are willing to Uber to-and-fro from the front door, this may fill the need. I wouldn’t recommend it for short stays given the six floors of steep stairs but for longer stays everything you could need is there.

Absolute gem of an apartment!! Exactly like the pics, this place was sparking clean, super comfy beds and beautifully decorated!
Communication was great, the check-in was easy and so welcoming. Value was superb and it's in a great location close to everything you could possibly want.
The 6 flights of stairs are not for those with mobility issues but equally not nearly as brutal as we had anticipated!! My husband, son and I found the neighbourhood friendly and safe and had a brilliant week staying here.
Excellent transport links to go exploring. Can't recommend it enough and we hope to come back and stay again another year!

What a wonderful stay at this apartment. The apartment is actually more spacious than the pictures and the interior is breathtaking as you walk in. The host paid attention to every little detail and made sure that nothing is missing. Linens and towels smelled fresh. The bed is very comfy and one can easily enjoy a deep sleep with no outside noise. The kitchen is well equipped and has an updated cutlery set. Having a dishwasher and a washing machine was very useful. The heating system keeps the apartment always warm and feeling cozy. All in all, the experience was great. The only downside perhaps is having the apartment on the 5th floor which can be challenging for the elderly and those who fancy an elevator.

description: Immerse yourself in the bustling energy of Pera, explore shops and art galleries, then relax in our inviting space. With comfortable amenities and local recommendations, we ensure a memorable stay. Discover Istanbul's magic from our centrally located haven. Book now for an unforgettable experience!

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend this place! The location was truly superb so convenient and in a neighborhood that felt safe and welcoming. The flight of stairs was manageable and not an issue for us at all. Mr. Cengiz was also responsive and helpful whenever we ran into any questions, which we really appreciated. The apartment itself was clean on arrival and had all the listed amenities, which made our stay comfortable and easy.
There were just a couple of minor things that could be improved. The water temperature was a bit tricky to get just right at times, and the dishwasher could have been cleaner when we first arrived. A drawer for clothing storage would have been a nice addition as well.
Overall, these were small details, and we had a great experience.

The apartment is at a very nice location. Close to the metro, main street and lots of restaurants, but also in a quiet area of the district. The surrounding inside looked even better than I expected from the photos. There is constant heating making the place warm and comfortable. Cengiz was always responsive and available to help if I needed anything. I would love to be his guest again next time when I visit Istanbul.

The apartment was beautiful and in a great location, close to the metro and Galata Tower. It made exploring the city easy, and the price was fair. However, there were some issues. The kitchen and bedroom had no curtains, and the living room curtains didn’t block the light well. Some furniture was damaged and not repaired or replaced. Also, the main shower head didn’t work, only the handheld one. I informed Mr. Cingez, who was very responsive and replied quickly to messages. He offered to send maintenance, but due to Ramadan and Eid, it was difficult to arrange. Overall, the apartment is lovely, the host was helpful, and the location is excellent. If the mentioned issues are fixed, it would be an even better place to stay.

We stayed just over two weeks in this apartment and overall we loved it, especially for the price point given how long we were there.
Pros: incredible location, super quiet and dark bedroom (which was perfect for sleeping), a really charming family room, and a really hot shower with great water pressure!
Cons: we had a few issues with some appliances breaking, but the owner was very quick to address them, which we really appreciated. The kitchen and bathroom are in need of a deep cleaning.

The apartment was in a great location, near the narrow alleys which leads to Istiklal street. Communication with Cengiz was great. The bedroom needs a little bit of maintenance, there were no curtains in there and the AC didn't work well.
The bathroom wasn't that clean especially the shower area. Nothing to comment on the living room and the kitchen, everything was good there.

description: From this centrally located place, you can easily access everything as a whole group. 5-minute walking distance to Nişantaşı, 10-minute walking distance to Taksim, Nişantaşı shopping center and cafes, 5-minute walking distance to Osmanbey, very close to the shopping center

reviews.text: Ahmet is a very nice host, who accepted our booking request on a very short notice and let us check in earlier. The apartment is bright and spacious, has everything you might need - from kitchen utensils to lots of blankets, towels, cleaning products, shampoo, etc. The location is also great, close to Taksim and Nisantasi, the transportation is convenient. It was calm and quiet at night, despite the lively area. We had a lovely family stay in this place!

Ev iyi bir konumdaydı; metroya yaklaşık 5 dakikalık yürüme mesafesindeydi. Ev sahibi iletişim konusunda nazik ve yardımcıydı; yaşanan aksaklıklar sonrası özür diledi ve iade sürecinde destek oldu. Konaklama sırasında hijyen, sıcak su ve ısınma ile ilgili bazı sorunlar yaşadık ve bu nedenle birkaç kez daire değiştirmek zorunda kaldık. Ev sahibinin yaklaşımı olumlu olsa da, genel deneyimimiz beklentilerimizi tam olarak karşılamadı.

Very friendly and helpful host. He solved the issues very quickly. The flat is well located and not noisy at all.

reviews.text: Great place to stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and communication with the host was easy and quick. Overall, I had a very pleasant stay and would definitely recommend it.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The place was spotless, well-furnished, and exactly as described. The host was incredibly responsive and made sure I had everything I needed. The location was perfect, close to great restaurants and public transportation. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay!

Son derece rahatlıkla tercih edebileceğiniz bi yer. Ev oldukça temiz ve düzenliydi her yer fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi. Konumu oldukça iyi bi yerdeydi kolaylıkla bulunabilir ve merkezi metroya yakın. Burak Bey de çok nazik ve misafirperverdi. Teşekkür ederiz.

description: Discover the vibrant charm of my studio apartment in a lively neighborhood. Just 5 minutes from Istiklal Street, you will immerse yourself in a vibrant atmosphere with a variety of restaurants, bars and cultural delicacies. Explore the dynamic nightlife, enjoy culinary experiences, and easily access Istanbul's iconic tourist attractions with a short 15-minute walk from Taksim Square. Experience the fascinating energy of the neighborhood and enjoy an unforgettable stay in the heart of Istanbul

reviews.text: Highly recommend. Perfect host. Very responsive. Clean. Comfortable.
Umut Bey kibar ilgili biri. Odalar temizdi. Konum taksim’e çok yakın. Ulaşım çok rahat. Geceleri biraz hareketli bir bölge. Tek kadın için zor olabilir. Teşekkürler.

Very friendly host, who accommodated my needs, such as early check in & late check out.
I also didn't want to be dragging my suitcase around streets, & the host allowed me to keep my huge suitcase in office.

description: From this centrally located place, you can walk to Istiklal Avenue in 5 minutes, Taksim Square in 15 minutes, Galata Tower in 15 minutes. You can reach Eminönü by going only a few stops from the bus stop, which is 1 minute away from the house. Tourist attractions you can visit are usually in the Eminönü area. You can reach all of them by using the tram. Our apartment consists of one room, one living room, a kitchen and a bathroom. 3 people can stay on the sofa set. We charge a nightly price difference.

reviews.text: The flat’s location is fantastic, just steps from Taksim Square and local amenities. It’s a clean, simple space, but it’s worth noting that it is very loud due to its position on a main road and a lack of soundproofing. The sleeping experience was difficult because there are no blinds/curtains—combined with the reflective ceilings, the car lights from the street are very bright at night. There is a constant stream of traffic. The bed is also on the very firm side. We were disappointed to be without Wi-Fi for four days (due to structural issues), though we appreciated the host’s quick response times to our messages.

Perfect stay — feels just like home!
I spent two wonderful weeks at this hotel, and I can honestly say it was one of the best stays I’ve ever had. Everything was spotless — the rooms, the facilities, and even the smallest details were perfectly clean and well cared for. The air conditioning and heating worked great, making the room comfortable in any weather.
The owner is incredibly friendly, helpful, and always made sure I had everything I needed. Their hospitality truly made me feel at home. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a peaceful, clean, and welcoming place to stay.

Cozy apartment in the heart of Beyoğlu, beautiful historical district of Istanbul.
Everything you need is nearby: cafes, restaurants, supermarkets, metro and bus stop.
The apartment was very clean and comfortable.
Thanks to the host for friendliness and responsiveness.
This was one of my best experiences on Airbnb.
Had a great stay! the place was clean and exactly as described. the host was responsive and helpful. I loved it and would definitely book it again.

We had a great stay at this apartment in Istanbul. The host was extremely friendly, helpful, and very knowledgeable about the city. He explained everything clearly and was always ready to help whenever we had questions or needed recommendations.
The location is very central, which makes it easy to explore the city. There are many good restaurants and nice places nearby, all within walking distance. The neighborhood feels friendly and safe, and we felt comfortable even taking evening walks.
The street is lively and full of people, which we actually enjoyed because it gave a real sense of the city’s energy. If you like being in the middle of the action, this is a great place to stay.
Overall, we had a very positive experience and would definitely recommend this apartment.

description:
You will feel as peaceful as at home in this private apartment in the heart of Beşiktaş. We offer you a living space free from the noise of the city, despite being in the center.
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place.

reviews.text:
We had a very disappointing experience with this listing. The apartment did not match the description at all — there was no dining table, no chairs, poor Wi-Fi, a very small bed, and no city or garden view as advertised since it was actually located in the basement. On top of that, the bathroom smelled, there were loud pipe noises, the lamps were low, and most shockingly, we found a used condom next to the bed. This made the place completely unacceptable and unhygienic.
Because of these issues, we had to leave immediately and book a hotel for the night, which cost us an additional 50€.
The only positive part of this experience is that Airbnb support handled our case and issued us a full refund. However, the listing itself was severely misrepresented, and I would not recommend it to other guests.

The apartment is at perfect location. It is a very quiet street but really close to restaurants, coffee shops and public transport. Overall the apartment is well equipped and clean. The things that i don't like was that the bathroom was really tight. The bedroom was a bit short too. I am not a tall guy(178) and my feet was on the end of the bed. So for this price i think it is a good place to stay.

The apartment was great, the host was pro actice, and reply fast and solve any issue that comes to your mind in a professional way, the apartment was just as described, the neighborhood is very peaceful and calm and close to many attractions. I will visit Istanbul again next year and for sure i will contact hakan and his super woman co-host aysha.
Temizlik, dairelerin durumu fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibi, sakin ama heryere yakın bir sokakta, iletişim harika, dört daireyide aynı anda misafirlerimle birlikte kiraladım, hepimiz çok memnun kaldık.

Great location . A little difficult if you have a car ( parking isn’t the easiest.)
Very cute little hideaway gem. Great owner that responds fast.
Very clean . Peaceful . Great value for your money . Will definitely stay again

description:
This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

1 minutes walking distance (100 meter), you will find; Taksim Square & Metro Station & Famous İstiklal Street & Tram Station (goes to Hagia Sophia & Sultanahmet)

The apartment has one living room, one bedroom and one bathroom. 65 metersquare

The apartment is ideal for single, couple and small family, it is suitable for leisure and business trips.

Ask for airport transfer

reviews.text:
We had a great stay overall. The apartment was exactly as described, clean,
and well maintained. The bed was very comfortable, and both the bathroom and the apartment were spotless. The host was very responsive and always replied quickly.
The location is excellent—only about a 2-minute walk to Taksim Square, with plenty of grocery stores nearby that stay open late, which was very convenient.
The only minor downside during our stay was that the living room and kitchen didn’t have air conditioning. However, we kept the bedroom AC running, and it cooled most of the apartment, so it wasn’t a major issue. I would also suggest replacing the bedroom curtains, as they don’t block sunlight completely, making it difficult to sleep during the day.
Overall, it was an excellent stay, easy to find, and I would happily recommend it.

I stayed at this apartment for two nights during my last trip to Istanbul and had a great experience overall. Communication with the host was seamless, the self-check-in process was straightforward, and the space matched the photos accurately. The internet connection was fast, and the location couldn't be better — just a short, if somewhat steep, walk to Taksim, with plenty of shops and restaurants within easy reach. For guests with luggage or mobility concerns, there's a small elevator available. The apartment is filled with natural light thanks to floor-to-ceiling windows, with curtains provided for privacy when needed. The sofa bed was a bit low for my preference, though still comfortable. One minor note: as the hot water runs on a gas boiler, there's a brief wait before it warms up in the shower. Overall, a solid stay and somewhere I'd happily return to.

Matt is a great host, very flexible about checkin and checkout. He sent a couple of messages during our stay to make sure everything was fine. The apartment was perfectly clean, everything is exactly as listed. I could even say that it looked better in person. The location is perfect if you want to be close to Taksim and without too much noise. It is not the first time we came to Istanbul and finding a flat with elevator is not easy, it is really convenient to have an elevator on the apartment when it is a fourth floor! The access to the flat is very easy. Thanks for everything! 😊

I recently stayed at this appartment and
honestly it exceeded my expectations.
The area was excellent - safe, peaceful, and close to everything. Markets, cafes, and transport were just a few minutes away.
Very clean, modern, and well-equipped.
The photos don't do it justice. Beds were comfortable, kitchen had everything we needed, and the overall vibe was very homely.
Super responsive and helpful. Check-in was smooth.
If you're visiting Turkey, this is the place to book.

We had a pleasant stay in this accommodation which is close to Taksim Square. Everything is easily accessible nearby: metro, bus, tram. The boat for the crossing is not too far either, you have to walk a little but it's worth it. The accommodation is clean and well-equipped, however an oven for cooking would have been ideal. The host is always available to answer our questions and advise us.
